gzugs che shos chu srin nya mid dang / de mid sogs ri bo chen po dang 'khrul pa ste/ dus lan re yang srog chags 'bum phrag du ma khong du 'gro zhing / ngoms pa med pa sogs sdug bsngal dang / sdig pa'i khur shin tu lci ba dag go /tshe'i ring shos kyang / mdzod las/ dud 'gro rnams/ mchog ring bskal pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal ni/ bying na gnas pa rnams 'dzam gling gi 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na/ rigs sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par mdo las bshad cing / kha 'thor ba gzhan ni de las 'phros pa ste/ de dag gi sdug bsngal yang bsdu na gsum las/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ bkres skom gyis nyen te/ bza' btung tshol ba'i phyir phyogs kun tu 'khyams te/ mtsho dang / mtshe'u dang / chu klung dang / khron pa sogs kyi drung du phyin pa na/ der ral gri dang mdung thung sogs mtshon cha drag po thogs pa rnams kyis 'gog cing skrod pa dang / ma bkag kyang rnag khrag dang thal tshan sogs su mthong bas/ longs spyod du mi rung ba sogs dang / nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ bza' btung rnyed du zin kyang / kha khab mig tsam du mi tshud/ mgrin pa pad snal tsam du mi thar/ lto ba ri'i gtos tsam mi khengs/ rkang lag 'jag ma tsam gyis mi theg pa sogs dang / zas skom nyid kyi sgrib pa can ni/ yul bzang po la longs spyod mi nus par/ bshang gci dang ngar snabs sogs mi gtsang zhing dri nga ba rnams za ba dang / kha cig rang gi sha gcod cing za ba sogs te/ ji ltar zos bzhin khong par phyin pa na/ thu lum 'bar ba sogs su gyur nas/ nang khrol dang don snying thams cad bsreg cing btub pas nyam thag pa'o/ /mdor na skyes tsam nyid nas bkres pa dang skom pas ni gzir/ sha dang pags pa ni skam/ skra dang sen mo ni ring / sdong dum mes tshig pa dang ni 'dra/ yid du 'ong ba'i longs spyod kyis ni phongs/ 'dod pa dang sred pas ni gdung /

chos kyi snang ba dang ni bral/ tsha grang ngal dub 'jigs skrag sogs kyis ni rtag tu mnar ba ste/ bshes springs las/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis/ /bskyed pas sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi bzad pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /kha cig pags rus lus shing gcer bu ste/ /ta la ya thog skam pa lta bu lags/ /kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste/ /zas su 'bar ba'i khar 'babs bye ma 'tshal/ /smad rigs 'gas ni rnag dang phyi sa dang / /khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed de/ /phan tshun gdong du 'tsheg cing mgrin pa nas/ /lba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo/ /yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni/ /zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur de dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang skam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /lus dang tshe'i tshad la nges pa med mod/ tshe ring shos spyi'i dbang du mdzad nas/ de nyid las/ bar chad med par sdug bsngal bsten gyur pa/ /nyes par spyad pa'i las kyi zhags pa ni/ /sra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig lo/ /lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /drug pa dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba/ grang ba'i dmyal ba/ nyi tshe nye 'khor ba ste rigs gsum du yod pa las/ dang po ni/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i 'og na mnar med la sogs pa'i tsha dmyal brgyad steng nas steng du brtsegs nas yod pa'i/ thog ma yang sos pa ni/ der skyes pa rnams zhe sdang gi las kyi dbang gis/ lag tu blangs tshad mtshon char gyur nas/

phan tshun drag tu btab pas sha zad ste/ 'gyel ba na nam mkha' nas yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra grags pas/ langs ste sngar bzhin bsnun pas/ sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong ba'o/ /gnyis pa thig nag pa ni/ dmyal srung rnams kyis/ lus la thig nag po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa btab te/ sog le dang sta re sogs mtshon cha me 'bar bas gsheg pa dang / btub pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus 'joms ni/ dmyal srung gis ded nas/ lcags kyi ri ra dang lug gi gdong pa 'dra ba 'dus pa'i bar du yang yang 'tshir bas/ khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /bzhi pa ngu 'bod ni/ lcags kyi sa gzhi me 'bar ba la/ ma bzod cing gnas dang skyabs tshol ba'i tshe/ lcags kyi khang pa mthong ste de'i nang du zhugs pas/ phyi nang thams cad mer 'bar bas smre sngags kyi 'o dod 'bod pa'o/ /lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags khang nyis rim dang / sdug bsngal snga ma las nyis 'gyur du che ba'o/ /drug pa tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar bas/ zhabs nas phug ste spyi bor 'thon pas/ dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ me lce 'bar zhing du ba 'thul ba dang / lcags las byas pa'i snod chen por zangs zhun 'bar ba'i nang du 'tshed pa dang / 'bar ba'i sa gzhir gan rkyal sogs su bzhag nas/ 'bar ba'i tho bas rdung zhing dmyal bar byed pa'o/ /bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ gsal shing rtse gsum pas zhabs nas phug ste/ phrag pa gnyis spyi bo dang gsum du mthon pa dang / gzhan yang sdug bsngal myong ba'i rten lus dang / rgyu las dang sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo rnams snga ma las rab tu che ba'o/ /brgyad pa mnar med pa ni/ phyogs bzhi nas rlung shugs drag pos bdas pa'i me lces/ dmyal ba pa de dag gi lus rtag tu 'bar bas/ smre sngags kyi sgra tsam las sems can du shes pa dang / dmyal srung rnams kyis me mdag 'bar ba'i nang du gan rkyal lam/ kha sbub tu bzhag ste phra skam 'bar bas lce phyung zhing brkyangs nas/

lcags kyi thong gshol me 'bar bas zhing bzhin du rmo ba dang / pags pa bshus pa'i shul du zangs leb 'bar bas dkris te/ tho ba 'bar bas rdung zhing rngan bgrang byed pa sogs/ skad cig tsam yang bar chad med par sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyams su myong ba'o/ /'di dag kyang dran pa nyer bzhag gi mdo dang / mngon pa'i gzhung lugs rnams nas zhib tu bshad mod/ bshes pa'i springs yig tu bsdus te bstan pa ni/ sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la/ /yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /kha cig til bzhin 'tshir ste de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar rlog /kha cig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /sta re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis gsheg /de bzhin gzhan dag khro chu bzhus pa yi/ /khu ba 'bar bas 'khrig pa ldud par bgyid/ /ces dang / kha cig mdag ma 'bar ba'i tshogs su ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rab bsreg kha yang bgrad/ /kha cig lcags las byas pa'i zangs chen du/ /spyi'u tshugs 'bras kyi cung phed bzhin du 'tshed/ /ces dang / bde ba kun gyi nang na sred zad pa'i/ /bde ba bdag po bgyid pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na ni/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzad/ /ces so/ /sdug bsngal de dag ji srid myong ba'i yun tshad ni/ spyi las ma zad kyi bar du 'chi 'pho bar mi nus pa ste/ de nyid las/ de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /bye brag so so'i tshe tshad kyang / /mdzod las/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /de nas tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/

/zhes dang / yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa grang ba'i dmyal ba ni/ mdzod las/ chu bur can sogs grang brgyad gzhan/ /zhes tsha dmyal brgyad kyi thad ka'i byang ngos su grang dmyal brgyad brtsegs nas gnas par gsungs te/ de'i thog ma chu bur can ni gangs kyi sbugs su rlung dmar gyis btab pas/ pags pa 'khums shing chu bur du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa chu bur rdol ba can ni/ snga ma bas kyang rlung dmar gyi shugs drag pas/ chu bur rdol nas chu ser 'dzag pa'o/ /gsum pa so tham tham pa ni/ shin tu grang bas nyen pas kha so 'thams shing so sgra krig krig byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa kyi hud zer ba ni/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pas kyi hud zhes smre sngags kyi nga ro chen po 'don pa'o/ /lnga pa a chu zer ba ni/ sdug bsngal shugs chen pos gdungs pas/ a chu zhes smre sngags chung ngu tsam las 'don mi nus pa'o/ /drug pa utpal ltar gas pa ni/ rlung dmar gyis btab pa'i dbang gis/ pags pa'i mdog sngon por gyur te kha lnga'am drug la sogs par gas pa'o/ /bdun pa padma ltar gas pa ni/ pags pa'i mdog snga ma las 'das te/ dmar por gyur cing kha bcu la sogs par gas pa'o/ /brgyad pa padma ltar cher gas pa ni/ pags pa shing tu dmar por gyur te/ kha brgya'am brgya las lhag par gas pa'o/ /de dag gi tshe tshad kyang / mdzod las/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ til sbyangs zhes sogs ni ma ga dha'i khal brgyad cu shong ba'i snod til gyis phyur bur bkang pa las/ lo brgya re zhing til re re phyung bas zad pa/ chu bur can gyi tshe'i tshad dang / 'og ma 'og ma rnams snga ma snga ma las nyi shus 'gyur du bstan pa'o/

/gsum pa nyi tshe nye 'khor ba las/ nyi tshe ba ni tsha grang gi gnas chen po rnams kyi nye logs dang / rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogs par gnas pa'i dmyal ba pa ste/ dge 'dun bsrungs kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /nye 'khor ba ni/ mdzod las/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /me ma mur dang ro myags dang / /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes pa ltar tsha dmyal rnams kyi phyi 'khor na gnas pa ste/ dang po me ma mur gyi 'obs pus nub tsam la/ der gnas pa rnams kyi rkang pa nub pa'i tshe/ sha pags thams cad tshig nas keng rus su 'gyur zhing / 'degs pa'i tshe gzhon sha can gyi sha gsar pa skye ba'o/ /gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam ni/ de'i phyi rol na phyi sa ltar dri nga zhing / me ltar rab tu tsha ba'i 'dam gyi nang du 'gyel ba na/ 'dam 'bu mchu rnon zhes bya ba/ lcags kyi mchu can gyis rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar du 'bigs pa'o/ /gsum pa spu gri'i lam sogs ni/ de'i yang phyi rol na spu gris gtams pa'i thang la 'gro ba na/ rkang pa 'deg 'jog gi tshe sha skye ba dang 'tshig pa dang / de dang 'dab chags su ral gri lo ma'i nags zhes pa/ shing gi lo ma ral gri 'bar bar gyur nas dmyal ba pa rnams kyi yan lag dang nying lag sogs gcod cing gtub pa'o/ /der 'bros shing 'gyel ba'i tshe khyi sre bo lcags kyi mche ba can rnams kyis za bar byed pa dang / de dang 'dab chags na shal ma li'i sdong po zhes bya ba/ lcags kyi sdong po tsher ma sor bcu drug pa rab tu mang po dang ldan pa rnams la/ las kyis ded pa rnams steng du 'dzeg pa'i tshe/ tsher ma'i rtse mo thur du phyogs pa dang / 'og tu 'bab pa'i tshe gyen du phyogs pas de dag gis sha pags rnams gcod cing gshegs par byed la/ khwa lcags kyi mchu sder can rnams mgo bo dang phrag par babs nas mig dang lce 'byin pa'o/ /de dag ni mtshon cha'i gnod par mtshungs pas phyogs gcig tu bgrang ngo /

/bzhi pa chu bo rab med ni/ 'gyur byed kyi tshwa chu khol ma'i nang du bying ba dang / steng du lding ba'i tshe sha dang pags pa tshig cing skye la/ 'gram ngogs su 'bros pa'i tshe gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams kyis rngan bgrang dang / gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa'o/ /bzhi po de dag gis tsha dmyal brgyad po re re zhing yang bskor nas yod mod/ phyogs bzhi'i dbye bas bcu drug bcu drug tu brtsi'o/ /tshul de dag kyang / bshes springs las/ slar yang me mur ro myags rgyu ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad phog snyam bgyi 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / dmyal bar 'thag gcod dbad pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'dab ma ral gri 'dra tshal nags rnams kyi/ /rkang lag rna ba sna gcod thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing rab 'bar ba/ /tsher ma can la kun tu brgyud par bgyid/ /kha cig lcags kyi mche ba ldan pa'i khyi/ /gtum pos dbad cing lag pa gnam du bsgreng / /dbang med gzhan dag lcags mchu rnon po dang / /sen mo mi bzad ldan pa'i khwa rnams 'thog /ces sogs dang / slar yang dmyal ba'i chu bo rab med pa/ /tsha sgo bzod brlag chu tshan 'jug 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes pa bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dmyal ba de dag gang du skyes kyang / tshad bzung du med pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi bgyi char yang mi phod do/ /zhes dang / dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs pa bskyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang dag thos pa tsam gyis kyang 'jigs pa chen po skye ba'i gnas/

de dag dang bar du dbugs 'byung rngub 'gags pa tsam las med bzhin du/ bag zon dang bral bar gnas pa ni/ snying med pa'i spyod par zad de/ de nyid las/ sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gags pa tsam zhig gi /dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam stong du/ /mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /mdor na srid pa khams gsum po mtha' dag ni/ me'i 'obs lta bu ste/ brnag par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal du mas rtag tu gdung ba'i phyir ro/ /spu gri'i thang lta bu ste/ lus dang / sems la zug rngu du mas zug par byed pa'i phyir/ mi gtsang ba'i dong lta bu ste/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i skyon sna tshogs kyis kun tu sbags pa'i phyir/ sha btson gyi khang pa lta bu ste/ nyam nga zhing thar bar dka' ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / de nyid las/ 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang / /dmyal ba dud 'gro yi dwags rnams dag tu/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ snying po med pa'i bya ba rnams spangs nas/ mu mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di las rang dang gzhan sgrol ba'i thabs la rnam pa kun tu 'bad par bya ste/ 'di las gal che ba'i bya ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /don gyi dbang 'di la dgongs nas/ dpal ldan klu'i dbang pos/ mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de dag phyir bzlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal lo/ /de las ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes rjes su gdams pa'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhib tu ma bsam na/ thar ba don gnyer gyi blo dang snying rje chen po skye ba'i go skabs med pas/ yang dang yang du bsams te thar lam sgrub pa la blo thag chod pa'i tshe/

de'i gtso bo yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che yin par shes nas/ 'di nyid kho na ci skye/ ci gnas/ ci 'phel gyi ched du/ go cha chen po bgo zhing dran shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres dang skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ 'khor ba'i skye 'chi thog ma med der 'gro ba'i lam ni rnam pa lnga/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i tshig ngag tu 'don zhing / don yid la sems par bya'o/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal 'bar ba me yi 'obs/ /sna tshogs skyon gyis sbags pa mi gtsang dong / /brgal dka' mu mtha' med pa srid pa'i mtsho/ /'di las yid 'byung byos shig thar 'dod rnams/ /de ltar sngon 'gro'i chos de dag la blo legs par sbyangs shing blang dor la 'bad na/ lam sgron sogs su bshad pa'i skyes bu chung 'bring gi nyams len gyi dgos pa thams cad yar ldan du 'du ba yin te/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas mngon mtho'i bde ba tsam gyi ched du blang dor la zhugs pa ni/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam rim yin pa'i phyir dang / srid pa mtha' dag me'i rlabs ltar mthong nas/ de las rang nyid grol ba'i ched du thar lam la brtson pa ni skyes bu 'bring gi lam rim yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / lam sgron las/ gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag pa/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /de ni skyes bu tha mar shes/ /srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing / /sdig pa'i las las ldog bdag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gong du bshad pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rang gi steng du bsams pas shas mi bzod pa na/

tshul des dpag ste mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal zad par 'dod cing de'i ched du/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa ni/ skyes bu chen po'i lam rim yin te/ de nyid las/ rang rgyud rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/ /skyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /zhes legs par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul 'di ltar go na gdams pa 'di'i nang du/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gyi nyer mkho thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'du bas/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyis gdul bya phal che ba rnams skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gyi bkri ba dang / blo mchog tu gyur pa 'ga' zhig blo sbyong gi gdams pas bkri ba'i gnad don phyin ci ma log par nges par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de'i phyir spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba las/ brtan par gyur nas gsang ba bstan/ zhes pa'i don/ kun rdzob byang sems brtan nas/ /snod min la gsang ba don dam byang sems bstan zhes/ de gnyis kyi go rim ston pa'o/ /des na gzhung 'ga' zhig las tshig rkang 'di mi 'byung ba dang / bla ma snga ma 'ga' zhig gis kyang / don dam byang sems thog mar sgom par mdzad pa ni/ 'gal ba cher med mod/ cung zad 'thad pa ma yin te/ gzhung dag pa 'ga' zhig las/ tshig 'di nyid 'byung ba'i phyir dang / lam spyi'i rnam bzhag phal che ba nas/ kun rdzob dang don dam/ thabs dang shes rab/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rim pas gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang bslab pa gsum dang / phar phyin drug la sogs pa'i rim pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na dang po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams len/ rjes thob kyi nyams len no/ /dang po ni/

gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang / /de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di yang thegs chen spyi'i gzhung lugs las/ rgyu 'bras bdun la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsgom pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni shing 'khyog po srong ba dang 'dra bar thog ma nyid nas/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ste/ 'di ni blo'i nus pa dman pa dag gi yul du mi rung ba/ rlabs po che'i sems sbyong / theg pa chen po'i myur lam rmad du byung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ /myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du/ sdom gsum rab dbye las kyang / bdag gzhan brje ba sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ des na bdag gzhan brje ba shes/ /de ni myur du rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de yi bar du 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gsungs/ /zhes rgyas par gsungs so/ /thabs 'di la ma brten par gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde 'bras phun sum tshogs pa rnams mi 'grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces dang / sdom gsum rab dbye las/ byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /chos gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes so/ /des na 'di la gsum/ len pa sgom pa gtong ba sgom pa/ spel ma sgom pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sgom pa'i 'thas pa dang / sgom tshul gyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ srid pa'i nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ bdag gces par 'dzin pa'i dgra bo 'di/ gnyen po stobs ldan gyis gzhom par rigs te/ skyes rabs las/ kye ma'i bdag la byams pa 'di/ /ha cang ma 'os mi bzod de/ /zhes dang / bdag la byams pa'i dgra bo de/

/'phel bar byed pa su zhig yod/ /zhes so/ /de lta min na/ bdag la chags shing gzhan la sdang ba'i sgo nas/ sdug bsngal dang sdig pa'i khur las 'da' ba med de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ skye bo rmongs pa rang gi bde don brtson/ /rtag tu de ma thob par sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / /'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jig dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa kun/ /de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen des ko bdag la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / 'di yis brgya phrag thams cad du/ /'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ byams pa la brten nas bsgom pa/ snying rje la brten nas bsgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems la brten nas bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces byams sogs tshad med pa re re yang khyad par bzhi ldan du gsungs te/ bral ba'i khyad par so so'i mi mthun phyogs spangs pa/ grogs kyi khyad par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ dmigs yul gyi khyad par sems can dang / chos dang / dmigs pa med pa ste gsum gsum la 'jug pa/ byed las kyi khyad par sems can rnams yongs su smin pa'o/ /de la 'dir skabs su bab pa ni sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa'o/ /de'i ngo bo ni/ dmigs yul sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang phrad par 'dod pa ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ 'gro la phan pa nyer sgrub pa/ /byams pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de yang thog mar rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs nas bsgom na skye bar sla bas/

rang gi ma mdun du gsal bar dmigs nas/ de nyid drin che ba'i tshul rnams bsam par bya ste/ dang po lto na gnas pa nas/ phyis kyi bar du nus pa ci yod dang / thabs gang shes kyi sgo nas bdag la phan pa mtha' dag bsgrubs/ gnod pa mtha' dag bsal/ bdag na ru dogs/ shi ru dogs nas/ sman dpyad rim gro sogs la skyo ngal med par 'bad/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bzung / byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ zas khas bsnyod/ dri ma lag gis phyis/ sha'i drod kyis bsros/ gces ming sna tshogs nas 'bod/ rang gis bzar mi bra ba'i zas/ gon du mi bra ba'i gos/ longs spyod du mi bra ba'i nor rdzas thams cad bdag la byin/ 'jig rten gyi brda dang tha snyad/ spyod lam dang / so nam thams cad bslabs/ mdor na bdag gi ched du sdig sdug sna tshogs kyi khur rnams khur ba'i tshul zhib tu bsam nas snying nye dung ba'i blo bskyed/ blo de skyes pa dang / tshe 'dir ma zad/ thog ma med pa nas yang dang yang du mar gyur nas drin gyis bskyangs pa ste/ mdo las/ sems can re res ma byas nas/ /nu zho 'thungs pa gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir snyam du drin dran par bya/ de nas drin can gyi ma de nyid bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge bas phongs pa'i tshul bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar da lan dal 'byor gyi lus tsam thob tu zin kyang / snying po len pa'i mthu ni med/ legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros dang ni bral/ dge ba sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor ni dman/ mi dge ba la rang ngang gis ni 'jug /des na mngon mtho'i bde ba tsam yang 'grub par dka' na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba lta ci smos/ zhes nges pa bskyed nas/ de'i phyir ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig de ltar 'gyur ba la de'i 'gal rkyen dang bral dgos pas/ 'di'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig pa'i khur ma lus pa bdag gi rgyud la smin par gyur cig

ces snying thag pa nas yid la smon zhing ngag tu'ang brjod par bya'o/ /de'i tshe ma'i sdig sdug thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par rang gi snying gi nang du nag 'ub kyis 'dus par bsam/ de la dga' ba chen po bsgom/ de la blo cung zad 'byongs pa na/ pha la sogs pa'i nye du mdza' bshes sogs gnyen gyi phyogs rnams la dmigs nas/ skye ba 'di dang snga ma rnams su drin che ba'i tshul bsam pa sogs sngar bzhin dang / de nas dgra gnyen bar ma'i phyogs dang / de nas dgra'i phyogs su bzung ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la dmigs nas 'di thams cad kyang thog ma med pa nas yang dang yang du bdag gi pha dang mar gyur cing / de'i tshe da lta'i pha ma bzhin du drin gyis bskyangs pa 'ba' zhig yin pa la/ skye shi 'phos nas ngo ma shes pas/ 'ga' zhig la chags shing / 'ga' zhig la sdang ba ni 'khrul pa kho na'i dbang gis so/ /de bas na drin can du mtshungs pa 'di thams cad bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa sogs sngar bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dmigs pa rgya bskyed de/ gling gcig dang / gling bzhi dang / stong gsum gyi sems can dang / mthar nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad la dmigs nas bsgom mo/ /tshul de dag kyang / sgom rim bar pa las/ sems can thams cad bde ba ni 'dod/ sdug bsngal ni mi 'dod la/ thog ma med pa can gyi 'khor ba na/ sems can gang lan brgyar bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa de gang yang med do snyam du bsam zhing / 'di la bye brag ci yod na/ la la la ni rjes su chags/ la la la ni khong khro bar gyur/ ces dang / byams pa bsgom pa ni mdza' bshes kyi phyogs thog mar byas nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa ste/ rim gyis tha mal pa dang / dgra la yang bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes legs par gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar byams pa bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ bye ba khrag khrig dkrigs pa'i zhig dag na/

/mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la nyin re rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ rje'u tshos sum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re dus gsum sbyin par kyang / /byams pa yud tsam thang cig gi /bsod nams dag la char mi phod/ /lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang / /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang / /dug dang mtshon gyis gnod med dang / /'bad pa med par don 'thob dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang / /byams chos yon tan brgyad 'thob bo/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang bla ma snga ma dag 'dza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam rgyud sogs/ /man ngag 'di yi gleng gzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdza' bo'i bu mo'i lo rgyus sogs kyang dran par bya'o/ /sna tshogs sdig pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ /shugs drag zhe sdang me lce 'jil ba'i thabs/ /rmad byung snying rje'i ljon shing 'phel ba'i rkyen/ /byams pa'i sems kyis bdag rgyud brlan par mdzod/ /gnyis pa snying rje la brten nas len pa bsgom pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa la/ snying rje bde blag tu skye bas/ de nas snying rje bsgom par bya ste/ sgom rim bar pa las/ byams pa'i chus sems kyi rgyud brlan te/ ser yod pa'i sa bzhin du byas la/ snying rje'i sa bon btab na bde blang tu shin tu yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /des na sems kyi rgyud byams pas bsgos nas snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de la snying rje'i ngo bo ni/ dmigs pa sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang ldan pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa de dag sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang bral bar 'dod pa ste/ de nyid las/ snying rje de ni sdug bsngal ba rnams de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /'di ni theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba/

rnam mkhyen rgyu'i gtso bo/ /thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba ste/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtog par bgyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig pu de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste snying rje chen po'o/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes so/ /de yang dang por rtsa ba'i ma mdun du dmigs nas/ drin che tshul rnams zhib tu bsam zhing / de ltar drin che ba 'di la drin lan 'jal ba'i phyir du/ phan pa bsgrub gnod pa bsal dgos pa las/ gang zhig gi phan/ gang zhing gis gnod snyam du brtags pa na/ phan byed ni bde ba dang dge ba/ gnod byed ni sdug bsngal dang sdig pa kho nar nges shing / ma 'di ni bde ba rgyu dang bcas pas phongs shing / sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa'i khur gyis non pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /ces pa ltar ro/ /des na 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'i skabs ltar/ ma'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kyang / grangs mang tshul/ shugs che lugs rnams yang dang yang du bsam pas/ shas mi bzod pa'i dbang gis/ ba spu ldang ba/ sha rtsa 'dar ba/ mchi ma 'khrugs pa sogs su gyur pa'i tshe/ ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mtha' dag dang bral na ci ma rung / bral bar gyur cig bral bar bya'o/ /bral bar 'gyur ba bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/

zhes ngag tu brjod cing snying thag pa nas bsgom mo/ /de ltar bsgom kyang snying rje ma skyes na/ sa phyogs dben zhing go skabs yangs par phyin nas/ mya ngan gyi 'phrul 'khor gyis 'dug cing / rang la rngan 'grang / mtshang 'bru/ khrel brda/ 'gyod bskyed de/ kye ma bdag ni skal ba ngan pa/ bsod nams chung ba/ thegs chen gyi rigs nus dman pa/ byang sems kyi lam la ma goms pa ste/ 'di ltar rtsa ba'i ma la yang snying rje mi skye ba'i tshul 'di ltar na/ bdag gi las mthar ni cir 'gyur/ ngang tshul ni ci 'dra/ bdag la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis ni ji ltar khrel na/ de bas na mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid bla ma dkon mchog khyed rnams kyis/ dman pa rjes su skyong ba'i thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag lta bu la lhag par yang gzigs nas/ myur du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya/ de nas slar yang ma mdun du dmigs nas sdug bsngal tshul zhib tu bsam pas/ sha rjen la me stag phog pa bzhin du snying tsha ram gyis byung ba na/ nga'i mā/ nga'i mā/ zhes skad gsang mthon por 'don zhing / blo shugs bskyed de snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /snying thag pa nas de sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod skyes pa na/ de'i rgyud kyi lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi zug rngu/ sgo gsum gyi nyes spyad/ mi 'dod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rang steng du len pa'i tshul sngar bzhin no/ /de nas dmigs yul rgya bskyed pa'i tshul snga ma bzhin du bya zhing / mthar gnod byed kyis gtso byas pa'i sems can mu mtha' med pa rnams gsal bar dmigs nas/ de dag re res kyang grangs mtha' med par ma byas tshul/ drin che tshul/ sdug bsngal tshul rnams zhib tu bsam pa dang / khyad par du gnod pa byed pa 'di dag kyang /

yang dang yang du mar gyur pa'i drin can yin pa la/ da lta ngo ma shes shing 'di nyid kyi nyon mongs kyis rgyu dang bdag gi las ngan gyis rkyen byas nas smyon pa bzhin du/ rang dbang med par gnod pa'i las la zhugs pas/ slar yang ngan 'gro rnams su lhung bar 'gyur te/ rje btsun mthu stobs dbang phyug gis/ gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang / /smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med/ /mi dge'i las kyis mnar med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'gro ba mtha' dag kyang / 'di lta bu'i ngang tshul las ma 'das pa ste/ bslab btus las/ nyon mongs kyis smyo gti mug ldong / /g.yang sa mang po'i lam du ni/ /gom pa re rer rdeg 'cha' ba/ /bdag dang gzhan rtag mya ngan gzhi/ /'gro ba rnams ni sdug bsngal mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar nges pa bskyed cing / don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /kye ma'o kyi hud 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma rgan 'di dag snying re rje na/ sngon tshe yang yang pha mar gyur pa'i ma rgan/ de tshe tshad med drin gyis bskyangs pa'i/ skye shi 'phos pa'i ngo ma shes pa'i/ smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med pa'i/ rang dang gzhan la gnod par zhugs pa'i/ srid pa'i 'dam du bying ba'i ma rgan 'di dag snying re rje na/ dngos 'dzin gdon kyis smyos pa'i/ nyon mongs nad kyis gdungs pa'i/ chags pa'i rgya mtshor g.yengs pa'i/ zhe sdang me lces dkrugs pa'i/ gti mug mun pas bsgribs pa'i/ nga rgyal ri bos non pa'i/ phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i/ ser sna'i mdud pas bsdams pa'i/ the tshom drwa bar chud pa'i/ lta ba'i nags su 'khyams pa'i/ las ngan rlung gis bdas pa'i/ sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba'i/ ngan 'gro'i g.yang du lhung ba'i/ tsha grang drag pos gzir pa'i/ bkres skom kho nas nyen pa'i/ glen lkugs smag gis khebs pa'i/ 'thab rtsod mtshon gyis gtses pa'i/

yongs tshol phongs pas ngal ba'i/ 'chi 'pho'i ltas kyis zin pa'i/ gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid pa'i/ bar do'i 'phrang la bgrod pa'i/ gcig pu nyam ngar rgyug pa'i/ sdig pa'i grogs kyis bslus pa'i/ bdud kyi zhags pas btab pa'i/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen bral ba'i/ mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i ma rgan 'di dag snying re rje na/ zhes sogs kha zhe ma 'dzol/ zol zog tu ma song bar/ sha la 'bab pa/ rus la 'them pa/ rang yid ches par bsgom pas/ gzhan sdug bsngal ba'i gta' mar rang 'jug par spro ba na/ sngar bzhin du len pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar snying rje chen po bsgom pa'i rim pa 'di yang / sgom rim bar pa las gsal bar gsungs te/ de nyid las/ de bas na 'gro ba mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal gyi me 'bar ba'i nang na zhugs pa yin par bltas la/ ji ltar bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ltar/ gzhan thams cad kyang de dang 'dra'o snyam du bsam zhing / kye ma kyi hud/ bdag la sdug pa'i sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal na/ sdug bsngal de las thar bar bya/ zhes bdag nyid sdug bsngal ba bzhin du byed cing / de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje de/ ting nge 'dzin la 'dug kyang rung / spyod lam thams cad du yang rung ste/ dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya ste/ thog ma kho nar mdza' bshes kyi phyogs rnams la/ ji skad smos pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong bar mthong bas bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sems can mnyam pa nyid kyi bye brag med par mthong nas/ sems can thams cad ni bdag gi gnyen du gyur pa kho na'o/ /snyam du yongs su bsam zhing bar ma'i phyogs rnams la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe de la mdza' bshes kyi phyogs rnams la/ snying rje de mnyam par zhugs pa de'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi bu chung ngu snying du sdug pa/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i ma bzhin du/

bdag nyid kyis shin tu sdug bsngal las gdon par 'dod pa'i rnam pa rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i snying rje de/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du zhugs pa de'i tshe rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ snying rje chen po'i ming yang 'thob bo/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du dmigs yul rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba ru bsam nas snying rje sgom pa'i tshul yang / mdo sde dag las shin tu gsal re re gsungs te/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa las/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni srid pa'i khol po/ chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo la zhen pas sbags pa/ rang dbang med pa/ bdag la mi 'bongs pa ste/ rang dbang yod cing bdag la 'bongs par bya ba dang bdag dga' bar 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du sems can la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po skye ba dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni phan tshun mi 'phrod pa khro ba dang / zhe sdang dang / gnod sems mang ba dag ste/ zhes dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba/ sdig pa'i las byed pa dag ste/ zhes dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni bskam pa/ chags pas zil gyi non pa/ chog mi shes shing 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi gnas pa dang bral ba dag ste/ zhes dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni ma rig pa dang gti mug gis ldongs pa/ bdag dang / sems can dang / srog dang / gsob dang / skye ba dang / gang zag la mngon par zhen pa dag ste/ zhes dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pa/ g.yo ba dang / rlom sems la gnas pa dag ste/ zhes dang / kye ma sems can 'di dag ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo bcad cing / ngan 'gro'i sgo phye ba dag ste/ zhes sogs dang / de dag la byang sems kyi snying rje skye tshul dang bcas pa zhib tu gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir rgyu med par 'bras bu 'dod pa rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/

chos kyi snying po snying rje'i sa bon 'debs pa la 'bad par bya ste/ 'di ni theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed kyi yang rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yod tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying brtse las rig bya/ zhes dang / de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ ces dang / snying rje chen po yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ /sems can rnams la snying rje su mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thar pa chen po'i khang bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /don gnyis dga' ston che la rol pa'i gzhi/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje'i sems/ /'bad pa du mas skyed cig skal bzang dag /gsum pa byang chub kyi sems la brten nas len pa bsgom pa ni/ de ltar bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang ldan pa la/ gzhan don sgrub 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems skye bas lam gyi gtso bo byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya ste/ 'di ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon/ theg pa chen po'i 'jug sgo/ bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o/ /nyes par byas pa thams cad sreg pas/ sreg pa'i bskal pa'i me lta bu'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos thams cad zad par byed pa'i phyir/ sa'i 'og lta bu'o/ /don thams cad yongs su sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o/ /'khor ba'i chu la rgyu ba 'don pas lcags kyu lta bu'o/ /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten lta bu ste/

mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad ji snyed yod pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan dang phan yon yang de snyed yod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'di las byung ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang 'di las skyes so/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ dbu ma snying po las kyang / byams pa dang ni snying rje dang / /shes rab chen pos brgyan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sa bon byang chub sems/ /de phyir mkhas pas de mi btang / /zhes so/ /sems bskyed de'i ngo bo yang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces pa ltar/ ched du bya ba gzhan don du thob bya rdzogs byang don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /'di la dbye sgo mang du yod kyang / skabs su bab pa ni smon sems gtso bor gyur pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed yin la/ 'di la yang rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed/ mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ lug rdzi lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams las/ 'dir bsgom par bya ba ni phyi ma ste/ 'di ni dang por rang nyid yal bar dor nas/ gzhan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par 'dod pa rlabs po che'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang / chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ni thog ma kho nar sems can thams cad byang chub par 'tshal bar bgyi ste/ bdag nyid ni ma lags so/ /zhes so/ /de ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul yang / mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung bzhin du/ rang nyid zhi ba don du gnyer ba ni khrel med pa ste/ slob springs las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ /klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/

/skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /de'i phyir/ rin chen phreng ba las/ ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gcig gi ched du yang / rang gi byang chub kyang yal bar bor nas gnas pa lta bu/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i khur 'khyer bar nus pa'i lhag bsam dang ldan par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa su'i lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gang gi lhag pa'i bsam pa ma 'khrugs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas bsgrub bya gzhan don de la yang mang du yod pa las/ spyir ni ji ltar 'tshams par thams cad bsgrub bya yin mod kyi/ mthar thug gi dbang du byas na/ mngon mtho tsam ni mtha' mi btsan zhing / sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa dang / dman pa'i byang chub dag kyang rang don ma rdzogs/ gzhan don mi 'grub/ mthar theg chen du 'jug dgos shing / de'i tshe yang sngon dman pa'i lam la goms pa'i dbang gis rtogs pa bul ba sogs/ nyes pa du ma yod pas bsgrub bya'i gtso bo ma yin no/ /des na sgrib gnyis ma lus pa spangs shing / sku gnyis kyi go 'phang la gnas nas/ don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba/ sangs rgyas kho na yin pas/ sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob na ci ma rung / thob par gyur cig thob par bya'o/ /thob par 'gyur ba bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig dril du bya'o/ /de nas de'i ched du/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyu kun 'byung / 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma/ mdor na mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad/ sa bon dang bcas/ bag chags dang bcas pa bdag gi rgyud la smin par gyur cig

ces sogs pa sgo sna tshogs/ rnam grangs sna tshogs/ thabs sna tshogs kyis len pa bsgom/ yul de dag nyes pa thams cad dang bral nas/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par bsgom zhing / dmigs thun gyi grangs bzung bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems lan re bsgom pa la yang / tshad med pa'i bsod nams 'byung bar gsungs te/ dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen dag gis kun bkang ste/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar bgyis te/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud na/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /zhes sogs dpe dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta min par byang chub kyi sems dang bral na/ lam gzhan la 'bad du zin kyang / zhi ba'i mthar lhung ba las ma 'das te/ rgyan las/ cher 'os sems bskyed spangs pa'i skye bo dag /gzhan don sems dang de yi thabs rnyed dang / /dgongs chen don dang de nyid mchog mthong ba'i/ /bde ba de spangs zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sems bskyed yod pa dang med pa'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs la nges pa bskyed nas/ sems de rang gzhan gyi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa/ 'phel ba'i thabs la nan tan gyis bslab par bya ste/ jo bos/ theg chen chos sgor 'jug 'dod pas/ /mun sel gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /nyi zla lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /bskal par 'bad pas skye yang rung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gal te smon sems tsam la phan yon chen po de lta bu mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ ma yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing /

/'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'ang / gtso bor smon sems kyi dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir dang / byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rdo rje rin po che chag kyang gser gyi rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad zil gyis gnon cing / rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par zlog go /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che nan tan dang bral yang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon cing / byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par zlog go /zhes sgrub pa'i nan tan dang bral ba'i smon sems kyi phan yon dpe dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i phyir dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las/ g.yo byas te byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gsungs na/ dge ba sna 'ga' byas te sems bskyed pa lta ci smos/ zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /snying rje'i chu gter gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / /lhag bsam gser gyi khyon yangs brtan dbus su/ /rigs mchog rin chen khams las legs grub pa'i/ /byang chub sems 'di srid dang zhi ba'i dpal/ /gnyis pa gtong ba bsgom pa la gnyis/ sgom pa'i 'thad pa/ sgom tshul gyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtong ba la blo sbyong ba'i tshul 'di ni/ gnad kyi gdams par shes par bya ste/ sems can thams cad la thog ma med pa nas kyi drin lan dang / lan chags bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'jal dgos pa'i phyir dang / sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs las/ sems can gang dag kha cig rtsod 'gyur ba/ /de yi gzhi rtsa yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ /de ltas gang la sred par 'gyur ba spongs/ /sred pa spang bar byas na gzungs su 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/

nyes pa'i rtsa ba ser sna'i kun 'dzin spongs dgos pa'i phyir dang / spyod 'jug las/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung / /sems can don las gzhan mi spyad/ /ces pa ltar/ ched du bya ba gzhan don kho na lhur len dgos pa'i phyir dang / de nyid las/ thams cad btang bar mya ngan 'das/ /bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub/ /thams cad btang bar chabs cig la/ /sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /ces pa ltar/ lus dang longs spyod sogs mthar 'bral ba'i chos can du nges shing da lta dngos dang bsam pas btang ba ni snying po len pa'i thabs dang / myang 'das sgrub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / bslab btus las/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dge ba dus gsum skyes pa rnams/ /sems can kun la btang ba dang / /de bsrung dag pa spel ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad mdor bsdu na/ lus dang / longs spyod dge rtsa gsum btang ba/ bsrung ba/ dag pa/ spel ba rnams su 'dus pa'i phyir dang / rin chen 'phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sa'i gnas lus longs spyod mdzad pa phun tshogs rnams kyi sgrub byed du nges pa'i phyir dang / sa la zhugs pa'i byang sems rnams kyis rlabs po che'i spyod pa dngos su mdzad pa rnams/ da lta bsam pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sgom tshul gyi rim pa la gsum/ lus gtong ba/ longs spyod gtong ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gtong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang sems yi dam gang rung gi thugs kar 'pho/ lus blos 'khyud tshad tsam gyi sngar bas che ba/ tsho ba mgre ba/ bkrag mdangs rgyas pa sogs su bsgom/ de nyid blos kha phye nas stong gsum khyab pa'i pags pa/ sha khrag rus pa/ nang khrol/ don snying / yan lag sogs su gyur par bsam/ 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/

mgron rigs bzhi la dbul/ gang 'dod dang ci 'os kyi dngos por gyur nas tshim par bsam/ khyad par du lan chags gdon bgegs rnams la sbyin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang dbang ba'i zas nor/ zhing khang sogs yo byad rnams mdun du dmigs/ zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod du blos sprul zhing byin gyis brlabs/ mgron rigs bzhi la phul bas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ dpag bsam gyi shing / bum pa bzang po/ rin po che'i gter bye ba khrag khrig sogs su gyur nas thams cad dgyes shing tshim par bsam/ khyad par du dbul phongs rnams la sbyin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa dus gsum gyi bsdus pa rnams blo yul du bya/ de nyid lung dang rtogs pa'i chos zad mi shes par byin gyis brlabs/ sems can thams cad la byin pas chos kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par bsgom/ khyad par du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ la la gcig tu nyes par spyod des yod/ /la la dkar po'i chos rnams kun tu bcom/ /la la thar pa cha mthun dge ba med/ /dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtshams med sogs byed pa/ log lta dang ldan pa/ rigs nus dman pa/ rigs kyi nyes pas bsgribs pa sogs chos kyi phongs pa rnams la sbyin/ gzhan yang / spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin gyi ni lus su bsgyur/ /zhes pa dang / sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /zhes sogs la brten nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu la brten pa'i blo sbyong dang / 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i blo sbyong sogs dam pa snga ma rnams kyi man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /tshul de dag kyang dri ma med pa'i mdo sde dag las 'byung ba'i sgom rim kho na ste/ 'di ltar lus gtong ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ lus 'di bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi bya ba ci yod pa la dengs par bya ste/ dper na sa'i khams dang /

chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / 'byung ba chen po bzhi po 'di dag sgo sna tshogs dang / rnam grangs sna tshogs dang / dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / yo byad sna tshogs dang / longs spyod sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams nye bar longs spyod par byed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i khog pa'i lus 'di/ sgo sna tshogs dang / rnam grangs sna tshogs dang / dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / yo byad sna tshogs dang / longs spyod sna tshogs kyis rgya cher sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar bya'o snyam te/ zhes spyir gtong ba'i tshul dang / sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ sems can gang dang gang la/ ci dang ci 'dod pa khyer cig lag pa 'dod pas lag pa khyer cig rkang pa 'dod pas rkang pa/ mig 'dod pas mig sha 'dod pas sha khrag 'dod pas khrag rkang 'dod pas rkang / yan lag dang nying lag 'dod pas yan lag dang nying lag mgo 'dod pas mgo khyer cig ces sogs so sor gtong ba'i tshul gsungs so/ /longs spyod gtong ba'i dbang du byas nas/ mdo de nyid las/ phyi rol gyi dngos po 'di lta ste/ nor dang / 'bru dang / gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che dang / rgyan dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang / bzhon pa dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / rgyal srid dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang / tshong dus dang / bran pho mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / bu dang / bu mo dang / g.yog rnams lta ci smos te/ sems can gang dang gang la/ gang dang gang gis/ ci dang ci dgos par 'gyur ba/ sems can de dang de dag la/ de dang de sbyin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /dge rtsa gtong ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'phags pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis phan 'dogs pas sems can thams cad la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis sems par byed pa dang / zhes sogs dang /

ci nas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi mtha' klas par 'gro ba thams cad la/ nye bar 'tsho ba dang phan par gyur cig de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis/ sems can thams cad kyi sems can dmyal ba'i ngan song rgyun chad par gyur cig dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i phung po rnam par log par gyur cig ces sogs dge rtsa gtong tshul spyir gsungs shing / blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ dus gsum gyi dge rtsa gtong tshul so sor phye nas rgyas par gsungs so/ /de ltar gtong ba gsum so sor bsgom pa ni gong ma rnams kyi phyag len yin mod/ dmigs thun nyung ngu la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor dmigs rnam rgya chen po'i sgo nas/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa gsum dus gcig tu gtong ba'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ de yang byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa kun slong dang / gtong ba sgom pa'i 'thad pa rnams gsal bar dran pa dang / lus bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar rnams gong ltar bya/ de nas bdag gi longs spyod dang dge rtsa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bdud rtsi la rim bzhin thim pas kha dog dri/ ro/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod dgu thams cad 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom/ de nyid las mtsho las rlangs chad pa'i tshul du 'od kyi phung po chen po rnams 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sprin gyi rnam par chags/ de las bdud rtsi'i zim char bsam gyis mi khyab par babs/ 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad bkru ba'i tshul du byas pas/ gnas lus longs spyod 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang lta bu 'ba' zhig tu bsgyur/ khyad par du dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron rigs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ rang rgyal nyan thos/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi spyan las du bdud rtsi'i char babs/

gang la gang 'tshams pa'i snod rnams gang / dgyes bzhin du gsol bas zag med kyi bde ba chen pos dgyes/ thugs dgongs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsgom/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rigs/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma dam tshig can/ mthu rtsa can/ byin rlabs can thams cad kyi spyan lam du sngar bzhin du bab cing gsol bas thams cad kyi thugs dam skong / bzhed pa grub/ nus stobs rgyas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las la brtson par bsgom/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rigs/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad/ dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad/ bar ma do na gnas pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyod yul du/ bdud rtsi'i sprin char bab pas/ so so'i rgyud kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ rgyu nyon mongs/ rkyen las ngan/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri mas bsdus pa thams cad sa bon dang bcas/ bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /zag med kyi bde bas rgyud tshim/ lung rtogs kyi yod tan phun tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ lan chags gdon bgegs kyi mgron rigs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bdud rigs sum brgya drug cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga sogs/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ srog dang gzi mdangs 'phrog pa/ sha la brkam pa khrag la sred pa/ bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad kyi spyod yul du sngar bzhin bab cing longs spyad pas/ thams can ngoms shing tshim/ bsam ngan gdug rtsub zhi/ lan chags dang sha 'khon byang / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams rgyud la skyes/ lus sems zag med kyi bde ba dang ldan/ phan tshun phan 'dogs kyi sbyor ba la zhugs par bsgom/ slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las/ char sprin gyi spro bsdu snga ma bzhin byas pas/ mgron rigs dang po mchod pa'i phyir du/ mchod yul re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa/ gser gyi sa gzhi la/

baiḍū rya yis mig mangs ris su bris pa/ mnan na nem byed cing / btegs na 'phar gyis byed pa/ 'od zer rab tu gsal ba/ rin po che'i ri rnams dang / rin po che'i ljon shing sna tshogs/ skyed tshal sna tshogs/ rdzing bu sna tshogs/ them skas sna tshogs/ khang bzang sna tshogs/ bzhugs khri sna tshogs/ de bzhin du yol ba/ bla re/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ gdugs/ lda ldi/ rgyan phreng / na bza'/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo sna tshogs pa rnams dang / gzhan yang rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs/ lha dang mi'i mchod rdzas/ gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya phun sum tshogs pa/ zag med kyi bde ba skyed nus/ dbang thob pa'i byang sems rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgom/ de bzhin du 'gron rigs gnyis pa rnams la yang / gang la gang 'tshams pa'i bzhugs gnas/ pho brang / gdan khri/ gos rgyan/ spyan gzigs/ dkor nor/ dam rdzas sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa sogs gong bzhin/ mgron rigs gsum pa rnams la yang rang rang gang 'dod pa'i gnas/ grogs/ gnyen/ mgon/ skyabs/ rten/ dpung gnyen/ 'khor/ bran/ zas/ gos/ sman/ nor/ 'bru/ bang mdzod/ rin po che'i gter la sogs pa zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod du gyur pa sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /mgron rigs bzhi pa la yang / rang rang gang 'dod pa'i sha/ khrag tshil/ rus pa/ rkang mar/ klad pa/ mkhris pa/ dbang po/ don snying / pags pa/ skra sen sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /slar yang spro bsdu gong bzhin byas pas/ bdud rtsi'i char bsam gyi mi khyab par bab pa las/ bdud rtsi'i thigs pa re re las kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'od zer re re'i rtse mor yang padmo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ madmo re re'i lte bar yang /

rang lus kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ de re res kyang mgron rigs dang po rnams kyi spyan sngar lus kyi bkod pa sna tshogs par mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis mchod bzhin du/ sgra dbyangs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sku gsung thugs yod tan phrin las kyi bsngags pa sna tshogs brjod pa'i bstod pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang / rang gi rtogs brjod sna tshogs bsgrags pas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs/ 'phags chung 'og ma rnams kyang / theg dman pa rnams theg chen du zhugs/ sa 'og ma rnams gong mar 'phar te spangs rtogs mthar phyin par bsgom/ mgron rigs gnyis pa rnams la yang / mchod bstod bskul ba rnams byas la/ rang rang gi phrin las la brtson par bsgom/ mgron rigs gsum pa rnams la yang / rang rang gi dbang po dang / bsam pa dang / khams dang / bag la nyal dang 'tshams par mngon mthos 'dul ba rnams la mngon mtho'i chos/ de bzhin du nyan thos kyi theg pas/ rang rgyal gyi theg pas/ byang sems kyi theg pas/ zab pa'i chos kyis rgya che ba'i chos kyis 'dul ba rnams la rgya che ba'i chos rnams bstan pas/ ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma rnams bsal/ ma dad pa rnams dad/ ma bsdus pa rnams bsdus/ ma smin pa rnams smin/ ma grol ba rnams grol ba mthar phyin par bsgom/ mgron rigs bzhi pa rnams la yang / zhi ba dang / drag po/ gang dang gang gis 'dul ba rnams la/ de dang de'i rnam pa sna tshogs bstan nas/ tshar bcad par 'os pa rnams tshar bcad/ rjes su bzung bar 'os pa rnams rjes su bzung ste/ rnam grol thar pa'i lam la bkod par bsgom/ de dag thams cad kyi skabs su yang 'khor gsum rnam dag gi shes rab kyis zin par bya/ chos sbyin gyi skabs su gtsug lag nas 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs par gdon/ mthar bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo/

/'di lta bu'i dmigs pa thun re bsgom pa la yang tshad med pa'i bsod nams 'byung bar nges te/ zhing gi khyad par srid zhi'i mgron rigs ma lus tshang ba'i phyir dang / bsam pa'i khyad par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams kyis zin pa'i phyir dang / dngos po'i khyad par lus longs spyod dge rtsa mtha' dag gtong ba'i phyir dang / cho ga'i khyad par dmigs rnam shin tu rgya chen po'i thabs mkhas dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / bsngo ba'i khyad par 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i bsngob dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rmad du byung ba'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'dis/ byang sems chen po rnams kyis smon lam chen po'i stobs las grub pa'i cho 'phrul chen pos mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba la dngos su phan 'dogs pa'i spyod pa rnams kyang myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de yang ji lta bu snyam na/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas/ nor bzang la/ bsod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan rgyas par brjod pa'i rjes su/ rigs kyi bu yud tsam zhig sdod dang de'u re mngon du 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod ma thag tu dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i sngon gyi smon lam gyis bos pa'i sems can grangs med pa zhig shar phyogs nas 'ongs par gyur to/ /de bzhin du phyogs thams cad nas 'ongs te/ de dag dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas stan sna tshogs la bkod de/ so so nas ci dga' ba'i kha zas tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang ldan pas yongs su tshim par byas so/ /yongs su bslab par byas so/ /yongs su mgu bar byas so/ /yongs su spro bar byas so/ /shin tu tshim par byas so/ /yid bde bar byas so/ /kha zas sna tshogs kyi ji lta ba de bzhin du/ btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ ro/ stan/ mal cha/

bzhon pa/ gos/ me tog phreng ba/ spos/ bdug spos/ byug pa/ phye ma/ rin po che/ rgyan/ rin po che'i shing rta/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ lha'i ba dan/ yo byad kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byas pa nas/ yid bde bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byas so/ /lha rnams la lha'i zhal zas kyis yongs su tshim par byas so/ /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byas pa nas/ yid bde bar 'gyur ba'i bar byas so/ /'on kyang phru ba de las god par 'gyur ba med/ 'grib pa med/ dmas pa med/ zad par 'gyur ba med/ sa tshigs su gyur pa med/ mthar thug pa med/ mur thug pa med/ ces gsungs pa lta bu ste/ mdo 'di las tshul 'di lta bu sha stag 'byung ngo / /gal te mos pa tsam gyi sgo nas sbyin byung gi bsod nams rgya chen po 'grub par dka'o snyam na ma yin te/ spyir dge sdig gi byed pa po'i gtso bo sems nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / khyad par du sbyin pa'i phar phyin sems la rag las tshul dogs gcod dang bcas pa yang / spyod 'jug las/ gal te 'gro ba dbul bor ba/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin yin na/ /da dung 'gro bkren yod na sngon/ /skyob pa ji ltar pha rol phyin/ /bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin yin te/ /de ltas de ni sems nyid do/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir dmigs rnam skyong tshul 'di dag ni/ gsung rab rgya chen po rnams dang / blo sbyong thor bu ba'i gdams pa dri ma med pa rnams las ci rigs par 'byung ba phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin pas/ sbal pa'i 'dom gyis rgya mtsho'i mtha' 'jal ba'i rtsis su mi bya bar/ dad pa shugs drag gi sgo nas nyams len la 'bad par bya ste/

bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi tshig don la dpyod pa zhugs na'ang tshul 'di nyid shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi dran shes brtan pa'i ched du/ spyod 'jug las/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang / /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams/ don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas kha ton du bya'o/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur nas/ /srid zhi'i mgron chen ma lus tshim byed pa/ /rlabs chen spyod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i tshul/ /'dod dgu'i gter 'di skal ldan rnams la sbyin/ /gsum pa gtong len spel mar bsgom pa ni/ gtso bor gong gi dmigs thun gnyis po re mos su spel nas bsgom pa yin la/ de dag goms shing brtan pa'i phyir du/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun nas gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par rang la 'dus pa dang / phyir 'gro ba dang bstun nas rang gi bde dge thams cad gzhan la smin par bsgom zhing / brgya stong la sogs pa'i grangs bzung bar bya'o/ /yang gzhung 'ga' zhig las/ len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsams/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ rang rgyud kyi myong nges kyi 'bras bu tshe smad du smin rgyu rnams/ da lta'i lus steng du len pa dang / phyi mar smin rgyu rnams tshe 'di yi lus steng du len pa ste/ blo rim gyis goms su 'jug pa'i thabs so/ /gzhan yang / spyod 'jug las/ dman sogs bdag tu byas pa dang / /gzhan nyid du ni bdag byas nas/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sems kyis su/ /phrag dog dang ni nga rgyal bsgom/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i tshul gyis kyang bdag gces 'dzin gzhom par bya'o/ /mdor na len pa ma bsgom na bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'khri ba mi chod/ gtong ba ma bsgom na bsod nams kyi tshogs mi rdzogs/ spel mar ma bsgom na goms pa bde blag tu mi 'grub pas/

dmigs thun gsum gyis sgom pa la 'bad par bya ste/ 'di ni theg chen lam gyi snying po dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngar bshad zin mod/ gzhan yang / phal po che las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag nyid la bsgyur bar ni mos/ bdag nyid 'gro ba kun gyi nye bar 'tsho ba'i lus su ni bsgyur/ zhes dang / mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam las/ sems dmyal gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal dang / /dud 'gro'i gnas rnams mi yi sdug bsngal dag /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phung po mtha' yas dag /bdag la 'bab gyur 'gro ba bde bar shog /ces dang / byams pa mchod sbyin gyi smon lam las/ srid rtse man chad mnar med yan chad dang / /'jig rten bgrang du med pa thams cad kyi/ /lha dang lha min lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs/ /bde bar gyur cig sdug bsngal bdag gis blangs/ /zhes sogs dang / spyod 'jug las/ de ltas bdag gnod zhi ba dang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid gzhan la btang bya dang / /gzhan rnams bdag bzhin bzung bar bya/ /zhes sogs sgom tshul dang / de ltar nges par gzhan dag gi /don la rab tu 'jug gyis dang / /thub pa'i bka' ni mi bslu bas/ /de yi 'bras bu phyis mthong 'gyur/ /gal te khyod kyis snga dus su/ /las 'di byas par gyur na ni/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bde min pa/ /gnas skabs 'di 'drar 'gyur mi srid/ /ces gzhan phan sems kyi 'bras bu mi bslu bar bshad pa rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /gal te bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i blo 'grub pa mi srid do snyam na/ ma yin te/ goms pa'i dbang gis 'grub pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar bdag med lus 'di la/ /goms pas bdag gi blo byung ba/ /de bzhin sems can gzhan la yang / /goms pas bdag blo cis mi skye/ /zhes so/ /nyes brgya'i rtsa ba bdag nyid gces 'dzin blo/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi sgo nas gzhom pa dang /

/bde legs kun 'byung gzhan phan byang chub sems/ /'bad pa du mas sgoms shig brtson ldan rnams/ /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi nyams len ni/ rjes kyi man ngag mdor bsdus pa/ /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /ces pa ste/ yul gzugs sgra sogs yid du 'ong ba dang / mi 'ong ba dang / bar ma gsum la brten nas rim bzhin du chags pa dang / sdang ba dang / rmongs pa'i dug gsum skye bas/ de dag dge rtsa gsum du bsgyur bar bya ste/ de yang chags pa skyes pa na/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags bdag la smin nas/ de dag 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa phun tshogs dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ gzhan gnyis la yang de bzhin du sbyar/ spyod lam thams cad du tshig gi sgo nas kyang sbyang bar bya ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang rung / /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge kun gyis/ /'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /ces dang / mthu stobs dbang phyug gi gdams pa las/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de dag bde thob shog /ces pa lta bu bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba dang / gzhan yang mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bur/ /dbang po'i spyod yul sna tshogs 'jug gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar rigs pa mthun tshig gis/ /sems can phan phyir de mngon 'du byed do/ /zhes pa'i don spyod yul yongs dag gi mdo nas gsungs pa ltar nyams su len pa'o/ /de'i tshul yang tshig zor yang ba'i phyir du/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i mdo de'i don bsdus kyi rjes su 'brangs nas shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ byang sems khyim gyi nang du 'dug pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad thar pa chen po'i grong khyer 'thob par gyur cig

ces tshig tu brjod cing snying thag pa nas bsgom mo/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ nyal ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku thob par gyur cig rmi lam byung na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs par/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe ma rig pa las sad par/ ldang ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku 'thob par/ gos gon pa'i tshe ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi gos gon par/ ska rags 'ching ba'i tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar/ stan la 'dug pa'i tshe byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje'i gdan 'thob par/ rgyab brten pa'i tshe byang chub kyi shing 'thob par/ me gtong ba'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i bud shing sreg par/ 'bar ba'i tshe ye shes kyi me 'bar bar/ g.yos zin pa'i tshe ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thob par/ zas za ba'i tshe bsam gtan gyi zas thob par/ phyi rol tu 'gro ba'i tshe 'khor ba'i grong khyer las thar bar/ skas la 'bab pa'i tshe sems can gyi don du 'khor bar 'jug par/ sgo 'byed pa'i tshe thar pa'i grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed par/ sgo gcod pa'i tshe ngan song gsum gyi sgo gcod par/ lam du 'jug pa'i tshe 'phags pa'i lam du 'jug par/ gyen la 'gro ba'i tshe sems can thams cad mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god par/ thur la 'bab pa'i tshe ngan song gsum rgyun gcod par/ sems can dang phrad pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang mjal bar/ rkang pa 'jog pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyi don la rton par/ rkang pa 'degs pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba las 'don par/ rgyan dang ldan pa mthong na mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyan thob par/ rgyan med pa mthong na sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par/ snod gang ba mthong na yon tan gyis gang bar/ stong pa mthong na skyon gyis stongs par/ sems can dga' ba mthong na chos la dga' bar/ mi dga' ba mthong na 'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad la mi dga' bar/ bde ba mthong na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba'i yo byad thob par/

sdug bsngal ba mthong na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed par/ nad pa mthong na nad thams cad las grol bar/ chu las brgal ba'i tshe 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar/ khrus byed pa'i tshe lus dang sems dri ma med par/ mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe 'gro ba thams cad kyi mchod pa'i rten du/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i tshe yon tan zad mi shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gyur cig zhes sogs bya ba ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la rung mthun brtsis nas blo sbyong bar shes par bya zhing / rgyas par ni mdo nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor 'di lta bu la gnas pa des ni tshad med pa'i gzhan don myur du 'grub par 'gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ khyod la bsgo bya khong du chud pa bya/ /ji ltar ji ltar ming du mis brtags nas/ /de la rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa des/ /de lta de ltar de la sems gzhol 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang / /de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya/ /gang la de yi sems yod pa/ /de ni de la don gyis zhugs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rdzun snang yul la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs dang / /tha mal spyod pa'i 'phrul 'khor ma lus pa/ /bla med dge ba'i gter du bsgyur ba'i thabs/ /gser 'gyur mchog 'dis don chen sgrub shig kye/ /gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ sgom pa'i 'thad pa dang / bsgom tshul gyi rim pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ kho bos byas pa'i mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i gdams pa zab don rab gsal sogs las shes par bya zhing / 'dor bsdu na/ bsgom rim bar pa las/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zab mo'i lam 'di la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'bad par bya ste/ sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa'i gnyen po ni 'di kho nar nges shing /

sgrib gnyis ma spangs par rnam mkhyen 'thob pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /de ni ji ltar sgom mi byed/ /ces so/ /'o na de'i ngo bo dang / sgom tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ sgom rim bar pa las/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa/ spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba/ shin tu gsal ba/ don dam pa'i spyod yul/ dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba/ rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun ltar mi g.yo ba'o/ /de 'grub pa ni rtag tugus par yun ring du/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor goms par byas pa las 'gyur te/ zhes dang / rgyan las kyang / chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes ni ngo bo yin la/ de yang zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces so/ /de'i phyir don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams len/ rjes thob kyi nyams len no/ /dang po la gnyis/ zhi gnas bsgom pa/ lhag mthong bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ zhi gnas kyi tshogs bsten pa/ dmigs pa la sems 'jog tshul/ grub pa'i tshad bsten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgom rim bar pa las/ de la zhi gnas kyi tshogs gang zhe na/ mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / bya ba mang po yongs su spangs pa dang / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / 'dod pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa yongs su spangs pa'o/ /de la yon tan lnga dang ldan pa ni/

mthun pa'i yul yin par shes par bya ste/ gos dang / zas la sogs pa tshegs med par rnyed pa'i phyir rnyed sla ba dang / skye bo mi srun pa dgra la sogs pa mi gnas pa'i phyir gnas bzang ba dang / nad med pa'i sa yin pas sa bzang ba dang / grogs tshul khrims dang ldan pa lta ba mtshungs pa yin pas grogs bzang ba dang / nyin mo skye bo mang po dag gis mi gang ba'i phyir dang / mtshan mo sgra chung ba'i phyir na legs par ldan pa'o/ /'dod pa chung ba gang zhe na/ chos gos la sogs pa bzang po'am/ mang po la lhag par chags pa med pa'o/ /chog shes pa gang zhe na/ chos gos la sogs pa ji tsam rnyed pas rtag tu chog shes pa gang yin pa'o/ /bya ba mang po yongs su spangs pa gang zhe na/ nyo tshong la sogs pa las ngan pa yongs su spangs pa dang / khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba dag dang ha cang smon 'dren byed pa yongs su spangs pa dang sman byed pa dang / skar ma brtsi ba la sogs pa yongs su spangs pa gang yin pa'o/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gang zhe na/ sdom pa gnyis ka la yang rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi mi 'dral ba dang / bag med pas dral na yang skyen pa skyen par 'gyod pas chos bzhin byed pa dang / nyan thos kyi sdom pa la pham pa bcos su mi rung bar gsungs pa de la yang / 'gyod pa dang ldan pa dang / phyis mi byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa yin/ sems gang gis las de byas pa'i sems de la ngo bo med par so sor rtog pa'i phyir ram/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par goms pa'i phyir/ de'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa kho na yin par brjod par bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'dod pa rnams la yang tshe 'di dang phyi ma la nyes dmigs rnam pa mang por 'gyur ba yid la byas la/ de dag la rnam par rtog pa spang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes nas rgyu tshogs de dag bsgrub par bya ste/ de dag dang mi ldan na mkhas pa dgyes pa'i zhi gnas mi 'grub pa'i phyir te/

mar me mdzad kyis/ zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams pas/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgom byas kyang / /lo ni stong phrag dag tu yang / /ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa la sems 'jog pa'i tshul yang / sgom rim bar pa las/ de la rnal 'byor pas bsgom pa'i dus na/ thog mar bya ba ci yod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas la/ bshang gci byas nas dgra'i tsher ma med pa yid du 'ong ba'i phyogs su/ bdag gis sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la dgod par bya'o snyam du bsam zhing 'gro ba mtha' dag mngon bar gdon pa'i bsam pa can gyi snying rje chen po mngon du byas la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yan lag lngas phyag byas la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs ri mo la sogs pa mdun du bzhag gam/ gzhan du yang rung ste/ de dag la ci nus kyis mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ rang gi sdig pa bshags nas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba byas la/ stan shin tu 'jam po bde ba la/ rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad kyi skyil mo krung rdo rje lta bu'am/ skyil mo krung phyed du yang rung ste/ mig ha cang yang mi dbye/ ha cang yang mi zum par sna'i rtse mor gtad cing / lus ha cang yang mi gug ha cang yang mi dgye bar drang por bsrang la dran pa nang du bzhag ste 'dug par bya'o/ /de nas phrag pa mnyam par bzhag la/ mgo mi mtho mi dma' zhing phyogs gcig tu ma yo bar bzhag ste/ sna nas lte bar drang por bzhag go /so dang mchu yang tha mal par bzhag go /lce yang so'i drung du bzhar ro/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba yang / sgra can dang / rngam pa dang / dbugs rgod bag can du mi btang gi /ci nas kyang mi tshor bar dal bu dal bus lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis/ dbugs nang du rngub pa dang / phyir 'byung bar 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas/ jo bos/ dmigs pa gang rung gcig dag la/ /yid ni dge la bzhag par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtshan bcas sam mtshan med kyi dmigs pa gang rung la sems 'jog par rung mod/ 'dir ni sgom rim las/ rnam pa gcig tu na ji ltar mthong ba dang / ji ltar thos pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la sems bzhag par bya ste/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ ji skad du/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis/ /'jig rten mgon po kun tu mdzes pa ste/ /dmigs pa de la gang gi sems 'jog pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam gzhag ces bya/ /zhes gang gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar rang gang la 'dod pa'i dmigs pa de la sems bzhag nas/ de nyid la phyir zhing rgyun tu sems bzhag par bya'o/ /zhes shes byed dang bcas pa gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi sku la sems bzung bar bya ste/ 'di la ni sems gnas 'grub pa tsam du ma zad/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par 'byung bar mdo sde dag las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe bying rgod sel ba'i tshul yang / sgom rim las/ de la nye bar bzhag nas sems la 'di ltar dpyad par bya ste/ ci dmigs pa legs par 'dzin tam/ 'on te bying ngam/ 'on te phyi rol gyi yul la rnam par 'phyar bas rnam par g.yengs sam snyam du brtag par bya'o/ /de la gal te rmugs pa dang gnyid kyis non nas sems bying du dogs par mthong na/ de'i tshe mchog tu dga' ba'i dngos po sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la sogs pa'am/ snang ba'i 'du shes yid la byas la bying ba zhi bar byas nas/ ci nas kyang dmigs pa de nyid sems kyis shin tu gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o/ /zhes dang / gang gi tshe phyi rol gyi gzugs la sogs pa la de dag gi yon tan rtog pas rgyug pa'i phyir ram/ gzhan yid la byed pas sam/ sngon myong ba'i yul la 'dod pas sems rgod pa'am/

rgod du dogs par mthong ba de'i tshe 'du byed thams cad mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa yid 'byung ba 'gyur ba'i dngos po yid la bya'o/ /de ltar rnam par g.yeng ba zhi bar byas nas dran pa dang / shes bzhin gyi thag pas yid kyi glang po dmigs pa'i sdong po de nyid la gdags par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bying ba dang rgod pa med par gyur te dmigs pa de la sems rnal du 'jug par mthong ba de'i tshe rtsol ba glod la btang snyoms su bya zhing / ji srid 'dod kyi bar du 'dug par bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /thun las ldang ba'i tshe ji ltar bya ba ni 'og nas 'chad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa grub pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/ de nyid las/ de'i lus dang sems gang gi tshe shin tu sbyangs par gyur pa dang / ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dmigs pa la sems dbang du gyur pa de'i tshe zhi gnas grub pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /ci'i phyir zhi gnas zhes bya snyam na/ de nyid las/ phyi rol gyi yul la rnam par g.yeng ba zhi nas/ nang du dmigs pa la rgyun du rang gi ngang gis 'jug la/ dga' ba dang shin tu sbyangs pa dang ldan pa'i sems nyid la gnas pa ni zhi gnas zhes bya'o/ /zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /des na shin sbyangs ma thob pa'i sems gnas skyon med rnams ni zhi gnas rjes mthun par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgom pa la gsum/ lhag mthong gi tshogs bsten pa/ ji ltar sgrub ba'i tshul/ grub pa'i tshad bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgom rim bar pa las/ lha mthong gi tshogs gang zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa dang / mang du thos pa yongs su btsal ba dang / tshul bzhin du sems pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtshan ldan gyi bshes gnyen bsten cing / mang du thos pa ci nus su bsgrub pa dang / khyad par du zab lam ston pa'i gzhung dang gdams ngag la thos pa dang bsam pas tshul bzhin du 'bad par bya ste/ jo bos/

tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi nges pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar gyis/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ lta bas spros pa bcad pa/ sgom pas nyams su blangs pa/ spyod pas bogs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ phyi yul la spros pa bcad pa/ nang sems la spros pa bcad pa/ sgom byed kyi gnyen po la spros pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /zhes pa ste/ de'i don yang sgom rim las/ chos zhes bya ba ni mdor bsdu na phung po lnga dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad do/ /de la phung po dang skye mched gzugs can gang dag yin pa de dag ni/ don dam par na sems kyi rnam pa las gud na med de/ de dag rdul phra rab tu bshig la/ rdul phra rab rnams kyang cha shas kyi ngo bo nyid so sor brtags na ngo bo nyid nges par bzung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na thog ma med pa'i dus nas gzugs la sogs pa yang dag pa ma yin pa la mngon par zhen pa'i dbang gis/ rmi lam na dmigs pa'i gzugs la sogs pa snang ba bzhin du/ byis pa rnams la sems nyid gzugs la sogs par phyi rol tu chad pa bzhin du snang gis/ don dam par na 'di la gzugs la sogs pa ni sems kyi rnam pa las gud na med do/ /zhes dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyin par gyi bag chags/ gnyid kyi rkyen gyi sad pas rmi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs 'byung yang snang ba ltar du grub pa cung zad kyang med pa bzhin/ thog ma med pa nas zhugs pa'i don snang gi bag chags/ las kyi rkyen gyis sad par bzung yul sna tshogs su snang ba yang / sems kyi rnam pa tsam las gzhan du snang ba ltar/ bden pa cung zad kyang med par nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang sems la spros pa bcad pa ni/ ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ ces pa ste 'di yang / sgom rim las/ de 'di snyam du khams gsum pa de ni sems tsam mo snyam du sems shing des de ltar chos gdags pa mtha' dag ni sems kho na yin par rtogs nas/
