sems de la so sor brtags na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid so sor brtags pa yin no/ /zhes sems kyi ngo bo nyid la so sor rtog go /de 'di ltar dpyod de/ don dam par na sems kyang bden par mi rung ste/ gang gi tshe rdzun pa'i ngo bo nyid gzugs la sogs pa'i rnam pa 'dzin pa'i sems nyid sna tshogs kyi rnam par snang ba de'i tshe/ de bden pa nyid du ga la 'gyur/ ji ltar gzugs la sogs pa de bzhin du/ sems kyang de las gud na med par rdzun pa nyid de/ ji ltar na gzugs la sogs pa sna tshogs kyi rnam pa yin zhes dpyad do/ /des de ltar shes rab kyis sems kyi ngo bo nyid la so sor brtags na/ don dam par sems ni nang du yang mi dmigs/ phyi rol tu yang mi dmigs/ gnyis ka med par yang mi dmigs so/ 'das pa'i sems kyang mi dmigs/ ma 'ongs pa'ang mi dmigs/ da ltar byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /sems skye ba'i tshe gang nas kyang ma 'ongs/ 'gag pa'i tshe gang du yang sogs par mi 'gro ste/ sems ni gzung du med pa/ bstan du med pa/ gzugs can ma yin pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ snang ba thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du shes nas/ sems kyi ngo bo la don dam 'jal ba'i rigs pas brtags pa na/ phyi nang dus gsum/ skye 'gag sogs spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bar nges pa'o/ /gsum pa sgom byed kyi gnyen po la spros pa bcad pa ni/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /zhes pa ste/ sgom rim las/ 'di ltar yang dag par so sor rtog pa nyid las/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i me 'byung na/ gtsub shing gtsubs pa'i me bzhin du/ rtog pa'i shing sreg go /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las kyang bka' stsal te/ de ltar skyon la mkhas pa des spros pa thams cad dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir stong pa nyid sgom pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de stong pa nyid sgom pa mang bas/

gnas gang dang gang du sems 'phro zhing sems mngon par dga' ba'i gnas de dang de dag gi ngo bo nyid yongs su btsal na stong par rtogs so/ /sems gang yin pa de yang brtags na stong par rtogs so/ /sems gang gis rtogs pa de yang ngo bo nyid kun tu btsal na stong par rtogs te/ de de ltar rtogs pas mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go /zhes 'byung ngo / /zhes mdo drangs nas bshad pa ltar/ yul sems gnyis la dpyad nas sgom pa'i tshe/ sgom byed kyi gnyen po la zhen par gyur na/ de nyid kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras la legs par dpyad pas gdod ma nas stong par nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom pas nyams su blang ba ni/ lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces pa ste/ spyir kun gzhi ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig la bshad pa mang yang / 'dir ni lam 'bras pa dag 'chad pa ltar/ rig stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin stong nyid la kun gzhi zhes bya ste/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ des na/ jo bos/ chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /shes pa yang spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yul chos nyid spros pa mtha' dang bral ba la/ yul can blo'i 'dzin stangs kyang ji skad bshad pa'i spros pa gcod tshul gyi sgo nas/ spros bral gyi rnam par zhugs pa na/ de las gzhan pa'i rtog dpyod/ spro bsdu/ 'bad rtsol sogs dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /tshul 'di yang / sgom rim las/ de ltar gang zag dang chos la bdag med pa'i de kho na la zhugs pa te/ yongs su brtag par bya ba gzhan med pas/ rtog pa dang / dpyod pa dang bral ba/ brjod pa med pa/ ngang gcig tu gyur pa'i yid la byed pa rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa/ mngon par 'du byed pa med pas de kho na nyid la shin tu gsal bar bsgom zhing 'dug par bya'o/ /der gnas nas sems kyi rgyun rnam par mi g.yeng bar bya'o/ byings rgod sel ba'i tshul nas sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/

gsum pa spyod pas bogs dbyung ba ni/ bdun po sems byung rtog pa yin pas spang / zhes pa ste/ tshogs drug gi shes pa dang / bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la nyon yid du btags pa dang bdun po/ rang rang gi 'khor sems byung dang bcas pa ni/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog ces bya ste/ dbus mtha' las/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i rtog pa de dag yul la 'phro zhing 'jug pa'i tshe/ bden snang dang / bden zhen gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ 'phro ba'i yul dang / 'phro byed kyi rtog pa'i ngo bo la rigs pas legs par dpyad nas/ spros bral du lhangs kyi nges par bya'o/ /de ltar thabs dang bcas pas yang dang yang du goms na/ rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du thams cad kyang spros bral ye shes skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas/ bogs 'byin zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa grub pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/ sgom rim las/ zhi gnas de nyid la dmigs pa'i tshe/ de kho na la rnam par dpyod pa de ni/ lhag mthong yin te/ zhes dang / de lus shin tu sbyangs pa dang / sems shin tu sbyangs pa thob nas/ de nyid la gnas te/ sems kyi rnam pa gzhan spangs nas/ ji ltar bsam pa'i chos de dag nyid nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul/ gzugs brnyan du so sor rtog par byed/ mos par byed do/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul/ gzugs brnyan de dag la/ shes bya'i don de rnam par 'byed pa dang / rab tu 'byed pa dang / yongs su rtogs pa dang / yongs su dpyod pa dang / bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / bye brag 'byed pa dang / blta ba dang / rtog pa gang yin pa de ni/ lha mthong zhes bya ste/ de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' lhag mthong la mkhas pa yin no/ /zhes dgongs 'grel gyi lung dang bcas pa gsungs pa ltar/ lus sems shin sbyangs dang ldan pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bo/

/de ni blo gzhan las nus pa lhag pa'i sgo nas/ yul gyi gnas tshul mthong ba'i phyir lhag mthong zhes bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong de dag kyang zung du 'brel bar nyams su len dgos te/ re res kho nas nyon mongs spong ba dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa sogs kyi dgos pa rdzogs par mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ des na zung du 'brel tshul dang bcas pa zhib tu shes par bya ste/ gzhan du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi nyams len ni/ thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ /zhes pa ste/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam thams cad du/ snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i dran shes dang ldan pas/ gzhan phan gyi spyod pa lhur blang bar bya ste/ sgom rim bar pa las/ lus la sogs pa la gnod par gyur na/ de'i bar skabs su 'jig rten mtha' dag sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / rmi lam dang / chu zla dang / mig yor lta bur blta zhing / 'di snyam du bsam par bya ste/ sems can 'di dag ni chos zab mo 'di lta bu khong du ma chud pas/ 'khor ba na kun tu nyon mongs par 'gyur gyis/ bdag gis ci nas kyang de dag chos nyid de khong du chud par 'gyur ba/ de ltar bya'o snyam du bsam zhing snying rje chen po dang / byang chub kyi sems mngon du bya'o/ /zhes dang / de nas dal bus skyil mo krung bshig ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas la/ de dag la mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas nas/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam chen po gdab bo/ /zhes sogs blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis thar lam lta ba'i mig dam pa 'di dag paṇa chen padma'i ngang tshul gyis thugs rje chen pos gsal bar gdams pa'i phyir ro/ /sna tshogs snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul dang / /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes shing / /gnyis med ye shes mtshan ma las 'das pas/

/tshul bzhin nges pa rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa song nas/ 'di man chad la/ snyan brgyud chen mo ba dag rjes kyi chos zhes ming btags nas/ don tshan gyi grangs dang / go rim la nges pa med par bzhed cing / rtsa tshig kyang mang nyung dang / go rim sna tshogs pa 'byung mod/ don bdun ma ltar na/ gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba ni/ snod bcud sdig pas 'khol ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor/ longs spyod/ nus mthu sdig pas khol zhing / bcom par rkyen ngan thams cad char bzhin 'bab pa'i tshe/ lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams pa gal che ste/ 'di med na chos rkyen dbang du 'chor ba'i phyir/ des na 'di la gnyis/ bsam pas lam du 'khyer ba/ sbyor bas lam du 'khyer ba'o/ /dang po la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la brten nas rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bya ba ni/ le lan thams cad gcig la gda'/ /kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /zhes pa ste/ rang la mi 'dod pa'i rkyen byung ba'i tshe/ lan khag gzhan la mi bskur bar/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag gces 'dzin yin tshul sngar bshad pa rnams dran par byas nas/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di yin brgya phrag thams cad du/ /'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas/ /da ni 'khon rnams dran byas te/ /khyod kyi rang don sems pa gzhom/ /zhes pa ltar/ le lan thams cad bdag gces 'dzin kho na la gda' bar bya ste/ 'di ltar/ khyod kyi dbang gis thog ma med pa nas/ da'i bar du mtho ba la phrag dog dma' ba la brnyas 'chos/ mnyam pa la 'gran sems sogs bsam sbyor du ma'i sgo nas/ gzhan la gnod pa sna tshogs byas/ de'i dbang gis bdag kyang ngan song gnas gsum gyi sdug bsngal sogs/ grangs mtha' med par nyams su myong ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis sngon chad sems can la/ /'di 'dra ba yi gnod pa byas/

/des na sems can gnod byed pa/ /bdag la sdug bsngal 'di 'byung rigs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /des na dgra zun gyi ru phyed/ spang gnyen ngos zin pa'i dus 'dir/ nyes pa'i rtsa ba khyod nyid gzhom par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ khyod kyis kho bo gar brlags pa'i/ /sngon gyi dus de gzhan yin gyi/ /ngas mthong da khyod gang du 'gro/ /khyod kyi dregs pa kun gzhom bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas/ gnod byed kyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad la drin can du blta bar bya ste/ re res kyang thog ma med pa nas pha mar gyur pas drin che tshul sogs dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba las/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i gang zag la/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis phan 'dogs mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas la brten nas dad sogs kyi yon tan 'grub pa bzhin du/ sems can la brten nas byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems/ phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams can 'grub pa'i phyir/ des na rgyu mtshan de dag yang yang bsam pa'i sgo nas/ gtong len gyi dmigs pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de ltar na 'gal rkyen ci byung thams cad kyang / me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa bzhin du/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'phel ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems la brten nas lam du bya ba ni/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir bsgom pa yi/ /stong nyid srung ba bla na med/ /ces pa ste/ 'gal rkyen gyis gzir ba'i tshe na/ 'khrul snang bden par bzung ba'i nyes dmigs dang / bden med du rtogs pa'i phan yon dran pa'i sgo nas/ 'gal rkyen de nyid la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyis stong tshul shes par bya ste/

de ltar na 'gal rkyen de nyid kyang don dam byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ tshul 'di la ni sku bzhi ngo sprod dam/ sku bzhi lam 'khyer zhes snga ma dag 'chad de/ dang por skye ba med pa chos sku dang chos mtshungs/ mthar 'gag pa med pa longs sku dang chos mtshungs/ bar du gnas pa med pa sprul sku dang chos mtshungs/ de dag dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid sku dang chos mtshungs shing / de ltar shes nas bsgom pas sku bzhi 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba la dgongs so/ /de ltar 'gal rkyen sogs stong nyid du rtogs shing bsgom pa la sogs pa 'di dag ni/ srung ba bla na med pa ste/ sdud pa las/ rgyu rnams bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te/ /stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sbyor bas rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du sgyur ba ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /ces gsungs te/ dang po tshogs bsags pa'i sbyor ba ni/ bdag la sdug bsngal byung zhing bde bas phongs pa'i tshe/ /bde ba'i rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang bral ba'i dbang gis yin par shes nas/ bde ba'i rgyur bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ba/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba/ gtong len gyi dmigs pa bsgom pa sogs gsod nams kyi tshogs la 'bad cing / khyad par du bla ma dang dkon mchog la maṇḍal phul nas/ bdag na bas legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos par legs na sos par/ shi bas legs na 'chi bar/ 'tsho bas legs na 'tsho bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol gdab drag tu bya'o/ /gnyis pa sdig pa sbyong ba'i sbyor ba ni/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa spongs shig pa'i brda chos su go bar byas nas/

sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang / skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sogs rten gyi stobs dang / stong nyid bsgom pa dang / gzungs sngags zlos pa sogs gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa tshad du longs par bya'o/ /'di ni sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs mchog rmad du byung ba ste/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo las/ byams pa chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa'i las byas shing bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rten gyi stobs dang / sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang / gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gdon la mchod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ nad bdag sogs kyi gdon rnams la gtor ma byin nas/ khyed kyis bdag gi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i grogs dang / skul ma byas pa drin che/ da dung yang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs phrin las bcol zhing gtong len bsgom par bya'o/ /bzhi pa chos skyong la mchod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul nas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen 'grub pa dang / rkyen ngan las du slongs pa dang / tshe rabs thams cad du byang chub kyi sems skye ba/ gnas pa/ 'phel ba/ mthar phyin pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'i/ nad gdon sogs dang bral ba dang / bde zhing skyid pa sogs kyi gsol gdab mi bya ste/ na ba dang / bde ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / thung ba sogs las gang legs rang gis mi shes shing / chos skyong sogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 'phral snang glo bur ba rnams lam du bslang ba'i phyir du/

'phral la gang thug sgom du sbyar/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam thams cad du/ tshogs drug gi shes pa dang phrad tshad kyi yul thams cad mthun phyogs/ mi mthon phyogs gnyis su nges pas/ mthun phyogs thams cad gzhan la gtong ba dang / mi mthun phyogs thams cad rang la len pa dang / stong nyid sgom pa sogs nyams len kyi dran shes dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du/ gnyis po tshang na thams cad blang / /zhes te/ mdze nad dang snying rlung sogs lus sems kyi sdug bsngal drag po dang / chags sdang sogs nyon mongs bzlog thabs med pa byung ba na/ de lta bu dag dang ldan pa'i sems can grangs mtha' med par shes nas/ de rnams kyi sdig sdug thams cad rang steng du len par bya'o/ /mdor na/ mi mthun sgom gyi grogs su bsgyur/ /zhes te/ phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ci byung yang byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /khyad par du/ rags pa gang yin sngon du sbyang / zhes te/ spang bya'i gtso bo'am rags pa bdag gces 'dzin du shes nas/ de nyid mgo gnon pa dang / drung 'byin pa'i ched du byang chub kyi sems gnyis la sogs pa'i chos thams cad bdag gces 'dzin kyi gnyen por 'gyur nges su nyams su len pa'o/ /lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa 'di dag gi nyams len gyi sna zin na/ rin po che gser gling du phyin na/ khyi la rdeg pa'i rdo mi rnyed ces pa bzhin du/ blo sbyong gi 'gal rkyen du 'gro ba'i chos mi srid par 'gyur bas/ rkyen ngan gyi ru 'dzings pa'i dus 'dir snying thag pa nas 'bad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa ni/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar par bya/ /zhes te/ dang po 'phen pa'i stobs ni/ da nas bzung ste zla ba 'di dang / lo 'di dang / ma shi'i bar dang / sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/

byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /zhes blo'i 'phen pa drag po yang dang yang du byed pa'o/ /goms pa'i stobs ni/ spro shugs chen po'i sgo nas sgo gsum sha thang chod pa'i gus sbyor dang / nyams len chu bo'i rgyun ltar sgrub pa'i rtag sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'o/ /dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs ni/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis skye ba dang / 'phel ba'i don du dmigs nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa sogs ci nus pa'i dge rtsa sgrub pa'o/ /sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi nyes dmigs sngar bshad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ gal te lha dang lha min rnams/ /thams cad bdag la dgrar langs kyang / /de dag gis bdag mnar med pa'i/ /me nang khrid cing 'jug mi nus/ /nyon mongs stobs can dgra 'dis ni/ /gang dang phrad na ri rab kyang / /thal ba yang ni mi lus pa/ /der bdag skad cig gcig la 'dor/ /zhes bdag 'dzin sogs nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams gnod tshabs che tshul dang / yang de nyid las/ bdag gi nyon mongs dgra bo gang / /dus ring thog ma med pa ltar/ /dgra gzhan kun kyang de ltar bur/ /yun ring thub pa ma yin no/ /zhes gnod yun ring tshul gsungs pa sogs dran pa'i sgo nas/ bdag 'dzin sogs kyi nyes dmigs yang dang yang du sems pa'o/ /smon lam gyi stobs ni/ dge sbyor thams cad kyi gsham du/ spyir 'khor gsum rnam dag gi bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs pa dang khyad par du tshe rabs thams cad du bsam pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sbyor ba lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du 'khyer nus par gyur cig ces sogs smon lam rnam dag la 'bad pa'o/ /de skad du yang / mdo las/

chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de yi 'bras bu de 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na chos 'di pa'i lugs kyi/ 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar byed snyam na/ theg chen 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ /stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ da lta nyid nas nam 'chi ba'i tshe na/ stobs lnga spyod lam dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dran par bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa gtong ba dang / gnyid log ka thams cad du de ltar nyams su len pa ni rgyun du sbyang ba'o/ /las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ stobs lnga'i nyams len shugs drags pa la 'bad pa dang / khyad par du dkar po sa bon gyi stobs/ phar phyin drug ldan du bsgrub pa ste/ de yang yo byad la ma chags par dkon mchog mchod pa sogs sbyin pa/ phyir bcos dang bshags bsdam sogs kyi sgo nas nyes ltung gis ma gos par byed pa tshul khrims/ 'khon zhugs pa rnams la 'khon sbyang ba sogs gang la yang zhe 'gras med par byed pa bzod pa/ blo sbyong sgom pa sogs dge ba sgrub pa la spro shugs bskyed pa brtson 'grus/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis sogs ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa bsam gtan/ gnas lugs kyi don la dpyod pa shes rab bo/ /de nas spyod lam gyi khyad par/ 'chi khar gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug lag pa g.yas pas 'gram pa g.yas pa brten/ mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas pa bkag rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu bar bya/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis gang la goms pa che ba de'i ngang du 'chi 'pho bar bya'o/ /mdor na 'da' kha ma'i gegs kyi gtso bo tshe 'di'i gnas lus longs spyod la zhen cing chags pa yin pas/ de nyed 'bad pa chen pos spang bar bya ste/ de yang phyi rol gyi bkye bkod la ltos pa med par/ blo sbyong gi gdams pa'i rtsis zin par bya ba ni/ chags yul rnams la snying po med par shes nas/

byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas kun nas bslangs te/ bdag nyid dbang ba'i gnas lus longs spyod 'di dag dgra'am/ gnyen nam/ bar ma'i phyogs su yang rung bas mthus 'phrog pa'am/ 'jab bus rku ba'am/ sgyu thabs kyis bslu ba sogs/ thabs tshul gang yang rung bas longs spyod pa de dag la/ rnam pa kun tu phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces yid kyis smon cing ngag tu yang gdon par bya'o/ /'dir yang rang nyid tshe 'pho ba'i shul gyi gnas lus longs spyod la snying po len pa'i thabs tshul bla na med pa ste/ gal che ba rgyang du mi bskyur bar dgos dus su nges par dran par bya'o/ /rkyen ngan rlung dmar sna tshogs ldang ba'i tshe/ /byang chub spyod pa'i grogs su sgyur byed cing / /rnam dag lam gyi snying po stobs chen lnga/ /nyams su len pa de dag rgyal ba'i sras/ /lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad dam rtags bstan pa ni/ byang ba'i tshad ni bzlog pa yin/ /ces te/ tha mal pa'i blo'i 'jug tshul las log nas/ lam gyi dmigs rnam gyi skabs so so'i myong ba rang ngang gis skyes pa ste/ dper na mi rtag pa bsgom pas tshe 'di don gnyer las blo log de bzhin du las 'bras bsgom pas mi dge ba las/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pas 'khor ba mtha' dag las/ kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pas bdag gces 'dzin las/ don dam byang chub sems bsgom pas mtshan mar 'dzin pa las blo log pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar na/ 'byongs rtags chen po lnga ldan yin/ /zhes pa/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' chen po/ nyes ltung mtha' dag la 'dzem pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po/ dka' spyad dpag med nyams su len pa'i dka' thub pa chen po/ rtag tu sgrub pa la brtson pa'i dge sbyor pa chen po/ bdag gzhan dang srid zhi ro snyoms pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po gcig tu 'gyur ba'o/ /mdor na/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /zhes pa theg pa gsum gyi chos thams cad bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i thabs su dgongs pa gcig pas/

nyams len bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por song ma song gi sgo nas/ rang rgyud la brtags te/ byang chub kyi sems la blo 'byongs pa dang / ma 'byongs pa'i tshags tshad shes par bya'o/ /gal te 'gro ba gzhan dag gis bzang por mthong ba sogs dpang po yin no snyam na/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung / /zhes pa/ chos dang ldan pa rnams kyis ma khrel ba'ang dpang po yin mod kyi/ de gtso bor mi bzung ste/ de dag phal che ba rnams kyis/ bdag gi sems mi rtog pa'i phyir/ des na chos dang sbyar ba'i rang sems kyis ma khrel ba gcig dpang po'i gtso bo bzung ste/ rang blo rang la lkog tu mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de yang / yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /zhes pa/ rkyen ngan lam khyer la gdeng thob pa'i stobs kyis gang la'ang nyam nga med par/ 'gal rkyen ci byung la'ang dga' ba sgom nus pa dang / yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /zhes pa/ rta rtsal can dag gzhan du yengs kyang / rta las mi ltung ba ltar glo bur ba'i gnod byed sogs/ rkyen ngan gyi thog rdzis gang byung yang 'bad rtsol drag po la mi ltos par/ gnod byed sogs la snying rje skye zhing / zhe sdang sogs rang 'gags su 'gro ba ni blo 'byongs pa'i tshad yin pas/ de lta bu'i skabs su bab pa'i tshe/ dga' spro chen po bskyed cing slar yang lam la 'bad par bya'o/ /drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig bstan pa ni/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /ces pa/ blo sbyong khas blangs dang ma 'gal ba/ tho cor ma shor ba/ phyogs rer ma lhung ba la bslab pa ste/ dang po ni/ kho bo cag blo sbyong ba yin pas/ sems srung kho na byed do zer nas/ bslab pa phra rags khyad du gsod pa yod de/ de dag spangs nas rang gis khas blangs pa'i bslab pa mtha' dag ma nyams par bsrung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag la gces 'dzin med par gzhan gyis go ba'i ched du/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ mtsho gnyan dkrug pa sogs tho co'i spyod pa rnams spangs te/

'brom ston chen pos/ rā sgreng du bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa'i bka' gdams kyi rnam thar bzhin bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mi'i gnod pa bzod la/ mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang / che ba la gus shing chung ba la brnyas pa dang / gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang ba sogs phyogs re ba rnams spangs te/ de dag kun la 'byongs par bslab pa'o/ /de'i tshe yang / 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /ces pa/ bsam pas bdag gces 'dzin gyi mdun pa der/ gzhan gces 'dzin du bsgyur zhing / sbyor bas chos ldan gyi grogs rnams dang spyod lam dang mtshungs par so thub par bya ste/ blo sbyong thams cad mngon mtshan chung la sa gcod che ba cig byed dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ zhes pa/ gzhan gyi yan lag nyams pa sogs skyon nas brjod pa'i tshig mi smra zhing / bsam pas kyang / gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /zhes pa/ spyir sems can thams cad dang / khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa rnams la skyon gyi phyogs nas/ skad cig kyang mi bsam par/ mdo las/ sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dag snang bsgom par bya zhing rang rgyud brtags nas/ nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyangs/ /zhes pa/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa gang shas che ba de'i gnyen por/ chos thams cad spangs nas de nyid thog mar 'dul ba dang / 'bras bu re ba thams cad spangs/ /zhes pa/ de ltar blo sbyangs pas rang don du rnyed bkur sogs tshe 'di dang / lha mi'i go 'phang sogs phyi ma'i bde ba dang / mthar thug myang 'das thob pa sogs/ 'bras bu'i re ba thams cad spang par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / dug can gyi zas spangs/ /zhes pa/ dge sbyor thams cad dngos po bden 'dzin dang / bdag gces 'dzin gyi dug dang ma 'dres par bya'o/ /gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ /zhes pa/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la 'khon 'dzin yun ring du mi bya'o/

/shags ngan ma dgod/ ces pa/ tshig gi sgo nas ngan shags kyi lan mi 'jal ba'o/ /'phrang ma sgug ces pa/ gnod lan 'jal ba'i skabs mi tshol ba'o/ /gnad la mi dbab/ ces pa/ mi'i mtshang nas 'bru ba dang / mi ma yin gyi srog sngags zlo ba sogs/ gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa'i las mi byed pa'o/ /mdzo khal glang la mi byo/ zhes pa/ rang la 'bab pa'i ju gal lam khag ngan sogs/ gzhan la mi bsgyur ba'o/ /mgyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ ces pa/ longs spyod snyan grags sogs/ thun mong ba rang gi sgos thob byed pa'i bsam sbyor spong ba'o/ /lto log mi bya/ zhes pa/ phugs rang bzang bar 'dod nas/ pham kha len pa dang / nad zhi gdon zhi sogs kyi phyir du blo sbyong ba ni lto chos dang 'dra bas/ de dag spang ba'o/ /lha bdud du mi dbab/ ces pa/ blo sbyong gi sgo nas nga rgyal dang / mngon rlom spangs te gang dang 'grogs kyang / bdag nyid bran gyi tha ma ltar dman sa bzung ba'o/ /skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol/ zhes pa/ rang skyid pa'i yan lag tu gzhan sdug par 'dod pa'i bsam sbyor spang bar bya ba'o/ /bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya ni/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes pa/ zas gos spyod lam sogs kyi rnal 'byor thams cad/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa 'ba' zhig gis bya ba'o/ /log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ zhes pa/ lam sgom pa'i skabs su na tsha/ 'dre gdon/ yul mi rnams sdang ba dang / rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs 'phel ba sogs/ mi 'dod pa byung ba na/ sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod mi mthun pa rnams/ rang steng du len pa'i sgo nas/ snying rje chen po sgom pa la blo thag phyogs gcig tu gcod pa'o/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /zhes pa/ thog mar 'phen pa gtong ba'i tshul/ sngar bshad pa lta bu dang / mtha' ma nyal ka'i tshe rjes lta bya ba ste/ ji ltar 'phen pa byas pa bzhin du grub bam/ ma grub brtags nas/ grub na dga' ba sgom/

ma grub na bshags pa byed pa sogs kyis rang blo chos kyi srang du 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /zhes pa/ 'byor rgud gnyis gang byung yang lam du slongs par bya ste/ de dag gi ngo bo dang rgyu rkyen thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas/ khengs pa dang / zhum pa med par byed pa'o/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos la bsrung / /zhes pa/ chos spyi dang / khyad par blo sbyong gi dam tshig srog bsdos su bsrung ste/ 'di med na/ 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang hrul bzhin chos kyi rtsa ba nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /zhes pa/ dang por nyon mongs kyi gnyen po dran par dka' bas dran pa/ bar du spang bya bzlog par dka' bas bzlog pa/ mtha' mar spang bya'i rgyun gcod par dka' bas rgyun gcod pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya ba'o/ /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /zhes pa/ phyi'i rgyu bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa/ nang gi rgyu rang blo chos la bkol du btub pa/ gnyis ka'i rgyu zas gos sogs chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dang ldan pa ste/ de dag sgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad pa'o/ /nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /zhes pa/ bla ma la mos gus nyams pa med pa/ blo sbyong sgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la srung sems nyams pa med pa ste/ de gsum dus rtag tu bsgom pa'o/ /'bral med gsum dang ldan pa bya/ zhes pa/ dus nam yang sgo gsum dge ba dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyong / /khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces/ /zhes pa/ dmigs yul nye ring / mthon dman/ phan 'dogs dang gnod skyel sogs phyogs re ba ma yin par/ thams cad la blo sbyong zhing mthar sems can thams cad la khyab par bya ba ste/ de yang kha tsam tshig tsam min par gting nas 'byongs par byed pa ni/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyi nyams len kun la gces pa'o/ /bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/

/zhes pa/ bye brag tu/ 'gran zla dang / zhe 'gras pa dang / phan lan du gnod pa byed pa sogs skye dka' ba dang / snga ma'i 'khon rnying yod pa sogs/ rang ngang gis mig snying du mi sdug ba dang / nad pa dang mgon med sogs sdug bsngal ba dang / pha ma sogs yul gnyan pa rnams la bsam pas blo sbyong bsgom zhing / sbyor bas phan 'dogs pa'o/ /rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya/ zhes pa/ mthun rkyen 'dzom pa dang / 'gal rkyen dang bral ba la mi ltos par gang byung lam du 'khyer ba'o/ /da res gtso bo nyams su blangs/ /zhes pa/ chos bsgrub pa'i glags skabs yod pa'i dus 'dir/ gtso bo drug nyams su blang bar bya ste/ tshe 'di phyi'i don las gtso bo phyi ma'i don dang / bshad sgrub gnyis las gtso bo sgrub pa/ chos gzhan dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis las gtso bo byang chub kyi sems/ lung rigs dang man ngag gnyis las gtso bo bla ma'i man ngag 'gro sdod kyi spyod lam gnyis las gtso bo yul gcig tu sdod pa/ nyon mongs skye ba'i yul sbyong ba dang / gnyen po bsten pa gnyis las gtso bo gnyen po bsten pa rnams nyams su len pa'o/ /go log mi bya/ zhes pa/ go log drug spong ba ste/ chos sgrub pa'i dka' spyad la mi bzod par/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs kyi sdug bsngal la bzod pa/ bzod pa go log lung rtogs kyi chos la mi 'dun par/ tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa/ 'dun pa go log sgrub pa nyams len gyi ro mi myong bar/ 'jig rten gyi bde ba'i ro myong ba/ ro myong go log sdig byed stobs can la snying rje mi bsgom par/ chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje bsgom pa/ snying rje go log chos la bskul ba'i gnyer sems mi byed par/ tshe 'di'i che thabs la sbyor ba gnyer sems go log gzhan gyi bde dge la dga' ba mi bsgom par/ gnod byed kyi sdug bsngal la dga' ba bsgom pa/ yi rang go log ste/

drug po de dag spangs nas/ phyin ci ma log pa drug nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /res 'jog mi bya/ zhes pa/ sgrub pa khral 'jal dang / nyams len thun tshags su mi bya bar yul dus kun tu rgyun ma chad par nyams su len pa'o/ /dol chod du sbyang / zhes pa/ gang drag gi blo rtse mang po med par/ blo sbyong nyid la blo 'gel byed pa'o/ /rtog dpyod gnyis kyi thar bar bya/ /zhes pa/ thos bsam sgom gsum byas tshad nyon mongs kyi gnyen por song ma song / kha zhe 'dzol ma 'dzol sogs/ rang rgyud la rtog dpyod yang dang yang du byed pa'i sgo nas nyon mongs kyi g.yul las thar bar bya'o/ /yus ma bsgom/ zhes pa/ gzhan la phan btags pa dang / rang gis chos bsgrub pa sogs/ gang gi sgo nas kyang gzhan la yus mi byed pa'o/ /ko long ma sdom/ zhes pa/ rang la gnod pa'i kha tshig dang spyod lam sogs byed pa byung ba na/ de la ko long dang ngan lan mi byed pa'o/ /yud tsam pa mi bya/ zhes pa/ gzhan dang 'grogs pa na dga' ba dang / mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur skyen pa spang ba'o/ /'or che ma 'dod/ ces pa/ gzhan phan gtso bor byas pa'i nyams len thams cad la/ tha na gzhan gyis legs so zhes pa'i tshig gi gtang rag tsam dang / snyan grags tsam la yang re ba med par bya'o/ /mdor na dam tshig dang / bslab bya de dag la tshul bzhin du gnas te mnyam rjes thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyar kha'i chu bo bzhin du 'phel ba'i thabs la rnam pa kun tu 'bad par bya'o/ /'khrul par goms pa'i bsam sbyor rgyun bzlog nas/ /theg mchog lam la ngang gis 'jug pa dang / /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig bslab bya rnams/ /ma nyams skyong 'di rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam/ /de nas/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di/ /byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yi/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/ /gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin/ /zhes pa/ dus dang / sems can dang / tshe dang / nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i snyigs ma ste/

lnga po 'di dag shin tu dar ba'i skabs 'dir/ bde ba'i rkyen nyung zhing sdug bsngal gyi rkyen mang bas/ lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa la gnad du bsnun te/ dug sman du bsgyur ba bzhin du rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i nying khu lta bu 'di ni/ mkhas pa chen po gser gling pa nas gtso bor brgyud pa yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di yan chad rgya gar nas byung ba'i snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang ngo / /de'i bsham du sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pas/ rang nyid mos pa mang ba'i rgyus/ /sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i man ngag zhus/ /da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do/ /zhes 'byung ba ni/ 'chad ka pa chen po rang gis dka' spyad du ma'i sgo nas gdams pa 'di nyid zhus shing nyams su blangs pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pas/ thugs rangs shing gdeng thob pa'i gsung ste/ sngar rtsa tshig 'di dag snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu yod pa las/ phyis yi ger 'god pa po yang / gtso bor 'chad ka pa'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/ blo sbyong nyams su len pa'i gang zag de'i lus la/ grong khyer chen po skyid pa'i 'byung gnas zhes kyang bya ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rkyen yang bde ba'i rgyur bsgyur nus pa'i phyir/ des na/ rtsom pa thams cad gcig dril du byas te/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man ngag 'di la/ rnam pa thams cad du 'bad pa'i sgo nas/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /kun mkhyen gsung rab zab yangs rgya mtsho che/ /rnam dpyod brtson pa'i rlung gis bsrubs pa las/ /dri med man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun mchog /gangs ri'i ljongs su deng nas gsal bar bab/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa mthar thug 'di/ /rgyal sras kun gyi 'jug ngogs mthar thug 'di/ /sde snod kun gyi nying khu mthar thug 'di/

/skye dgu kun gyi nyer 'tsho mthar thug 'di/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i nyon mongs nad gso zhing / /nyes pa'i dri ma mtha' dag sel ba dang / /'chi med bde chen dpal la spyod 'dod pa'i/ /skal ldan rnams kyi dga' ston ched du bsgrubs/ /blo ngan zhen lta'i khung bur zhugs pa rnams/ /legs bshad 'od stong dra ba mi mthong zhing / /dri med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun mi myong ba/ /e ma'o de la gang gis ji ltar phan/ /thub bstan nyi ma dus kyi nub ris bsgribs/ /'gro ba'i blo mig phyogs lhung skyon gyis khebs/ /'jig rten dge legs log 'dren bdud kyis bcom/ /dus 'dir bdag gi 'bad pas ci zhig bya/ /gus ldan slob ma shin tu mang po yis/ /yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' ye shes dpal/ /bzang pos brtse ba'i sems kyis 'di sbyar ro/ /gal te 'di la ma bshad log bshad dang / /dus las 'gyangs sogs nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras mkhas pa'i tshogs la bshags/ /bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /rnam dkar bsam pas legs par bshad pa yi/ /dge ba 'di yang mkha' nyams 'gro la bsngo/ /kun kyang byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog/ ༈ /theg chen blo sbyong gi man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhyen brtse tshad med pa'i bdag nyid yongs 'dzin sems dpa' chen po du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor gus par blangs shing / gsung gi bdud rtsi yun ring du myangs pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa kun dga' ye shes kyis ri khrod bde chen du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ dad brtson blo gros la sogs yon tan du ma'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing / lam 'di la rab tu gus pa dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis so/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas nas/

yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ ///shubhaṃ/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// ༈ /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi smon lam byang chub lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la thugs brtse dus las mi yol ba'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /snying nas khyed kyi rjes su slob pa'i phyir/ /smon pa 'di dag 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' yas 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang / /shes nas dad pa thob pa'i mos gus kyis/ /byang chub bar du bla ma dkon mchog la/ /khyed shes blo yis skyabs su 'gro bar shog /rnyed dka'i lus 'di yun ring mi sdod cing / /gang du skyes kyang bde ba'i skabs med la/ /dge sdig las 'bras bslu ba med mthong nas/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos la 'jug par shog /srid pa'i zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa'i sman/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i phan bde mchog gi gter/ /rgyal ba sras bcas skyed byed byams pa'i yum/ /byang chub sems la yid ches brtan par shog /ci tsam 'byor yang rloms pa mi skye zhing / /shin tu rgud kyang zhum pa mi 'byung ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi blo stobs rgya che ba/ /bdag gi snying la nges par 'byung bar shog /gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po'i don/ /rgyal sras yongs kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma byang chub sems/ /myur du bdag gi rgyud la skye bar shog /sems snang 'khrul pa rmi lam lta bu'i chos/ /skye med spros dang bral bar legs mthong nas/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'khrul snang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /yang yang phan btags drin gyi bskyangs pa'i gnyen/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba 'di mthong nas/ /bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun la byams brtses khyab par shog /thog med dus nas pha mar gyur pa yi/ /'gro ba'i sdig sdug rang la len pa dang /

/bdag gi bde dge gzhan la ster ba yi/ /mchog tu bstan pa'i lhag bsam 'bar bar shog /ma rig chags sdang nyon mongs 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i snang ba gang shar yang / /'bar ba'i me la bud shing bsnan pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems kyi grogs su 'gro bar shog /'ching byed 'khor ba'i nyon mongs kun gyi rgyu/ /las ngan sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /byang chub lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin rtsad nas thon par shog /las kyis bdud rtsi rnag tu snang ba bzhin/ /gzhan skyon mthong ba rang snang ma dag par/ /shes nas bde legs yod tan rgya mtsho yis/ /'byung gnas 'gro ba gzhan la gus par shog /sdug bsngal brnyas dang gtam ngan la sogs pa/ /mi 'dod sna tshogs thog tu babs na yang / /rgyal sras spyod pa'i grogs su mthong nas ni/ /rab dga'i sems kyis dang du len par shog /srid pa'i phun tshogs rmi lam lta bu'i chos/ /'byor yang de la zhen pa mi skye zhing / /gzhan la phan pa'i thabs su mthong ba na/ /lus srog gtong la zhum pa med par shog /rang gis yun ring gces par bskyangs pa'i mis/ /rang la dgra bzhin lta bar byed na yang / /slar yang brtse bas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /de yi phan bde bdag gis spel bar shog /sha khrag la dga' 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus 'di za bar byed na yang / /rang la gces 'dzin rtog pa mi g.yo zhing / /brtse bas de la phan thogs nus par shog /gdod nas zhi ba sems kyi chos nyid las/ /sna tshogs chos kun g.yo ba med mthong nas/ /'khrul snang rkyen ngan chu zla'i rdzun ris kyis/ /chos nyid don la gsal snang 'dren par shog /gnod byed thams cad dge ba'i bshes su mthong / /sdug bsngal thams cad sems kyi rgyan du rig /'gal rkyen thams cad dge ba'i bskul ma ru/ /mthong nas rkyen ngan lam du longs par shog /rang bde don gnyer rang gi dgra bor shes/

/tha mal dgra bo byang chub grogs su shar/ /na tsha sdug bsngal sdig pa'i dag byed du/ /mthong nas rkyen ngan lam du longs par shog /ltas ngan phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i rkyen du mthong / /'dre gdon dngos grub stsol ba'i grogs su shar/ /'khor ngan log sgrub rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du/ /shes nas rkyen ngan lam du longs par shog /blang dor shes pas bsags sbyang gnad du khel/ /bsrung ma mnyes pas bar chad bdud las rgyal/ /thabs la mkhas pas bgegs rigs grogs su shar/ /rnam bzhi'i sbyor ba nyams su lon par shog /shin tu spro bas 'phen pa'i go bgos nas/ /bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i chos la blo sbyangs shing / /rnam dkar thabs dang smon pa'i grogs dang bcas/ /tshe dang dam pa'i chos spyod snyom par shog /rtag tu bla ma dran pa'i mos gus dang / /bden gnyis byang chub sems la legs goms pas/ /zab yangs chos 'di'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /'chi ba'i bsod nams bdag la yod par shog /mi dang mi min 'byung pos gtses pa dang / /'byung 'khrugs lus kyi zug rngu langs pa dang / /shugs drag nyon mongs skyes pa'i dus su yang / /byang chub sems mchog nyams pa med par shog /'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag shar ba dang / /ma yi mngal dang tshe rabs gzhan du yang / /chos kyi snying po sems mchog rin po che/ /skad cig tsam yang brjed par ma gyur cig /'khor gyi dbus su yang dag lam bzang 'di/ /sgrogs pa'i rgyal dang de sras dge ba'i bshes/ /tshe rabs kun du bla mar bsten nas ni/ /chos 'di 'dzin cing gzhan la phan par shog /bdag 'dzin thul bas ci byas chos su song / /re dogs zad pas gang byung grogs su shar/ /lhag bsam 'byongs pas gzhan phyir rang nyid kyis/ /sdug bsngal myong yang rab dga' 'phel bar shog /lta ba 'dzin pa'i dug gis ma sbags shing / /snying rje phyogs ris zhen pas ma bcings pas/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug sems mchog rin po ches/

/srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa sel bar shog /lus ngag spyod pa tha mal 'dug na yang / /bsam pa byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /kun spyod bcos pa'i dge ba ma byas kyang / /kun slong dbang gis tshogs chen rdzogs par shog /lus srog longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du nyin bzhin bsngo na yang / /rang bde don gnyer lan la re ba'i blo/ /skad cig tsam yang skye bar ma gyur cig /pham kha blangs te rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul/ /dman sa bzung nas 'gro kun spyi bos bkur/ /gnod pa byed la lan du phan 'dogs pa'i/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin par shog /bla mar gus shing ci gsung dang du len/ /sna tshogs chos kun nyams len gcig la dril/ /re dogs spangs te rtag tu gzhan don la/ /brtson pa'i go cha bdag gis bgo bar shog /gzhan la gnod na thar pa'i bde ba yang / /bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin yal bar bor nas ni/ /gzhan la phan na ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa la/ /skyed tshal bzhin du dga' bas 'jug par shog /rnam gsum bslab pa mig gi 'bras bzhin bsrung / /sgo gsum bya ba chos dang mi 'bral zhing / /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /'khor gsum yongs dag bsngo bas zin par shog /gting mtha' mi mngon rgya chen spyod pa'i mtsho/ /dge legs yon tan rin chen bye ba'i gter/ /dbang tshogs kyi bsti gnas der/ /bdag kyang dga' ba'i yid kyis 'jug par shog /sna tshogs sdug bsngal khur gyis non pa la/ /bgrang yas thabs mkhas gnyen po'i khyad par gyis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i phan bde spel byed cing / /ting 'dzin mthu chen bdag gis thob par shog /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho dpag gis mi langs pas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yon tan chu bo'i gter/ /bdag blo rgya mtsho'i snod du legs bsdus nas/ /phrin las rgya mtsho ro gcig 'gyur ba shog /ces theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i blo sbyong gi tshig rnams smon tshig tu bris pa 'di ni chos 'di la snying nas mos pa blo gros gzhan phan zla bas bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig

/chos rnams kun gyi snying po byang chub sems/ /ma lus gcig tu 'dom pa'i gzhung bzang 'di/ /spar du bsgrubs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba yis/ /blo bzang dpal rdo tshul khrims la sogs pa/ /'brel thogs rnams kyi gtso byas sems can rnams/ /lam bzang 'di la/ /(yon tan )rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog/ //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //zhes pa'i shing spar las bshus te/ thar lam dgon gyi bla rgan bde bar gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs nyi ma lags kyis ma dpe g.yar gnang ba dang / pa sangs tshe ring lags kyis ma dpe 'tshol ba'i ngal ba mdzad pa/ chos skyong 'gyur med lags dang bstan pa ye shes lags kyis par zhus gnang ba/ kun dga' tshe ring dang e waṃ gnyis kyi rtsis 'khor du dpe sgrig dang par zhus tshar du ma byas pa bcas la bka' drin che zhes zhu zhing / gzhung dngos kyi sa bcad thad dbri bsnan med par phreng re phab cing de la bstun nas dkar chag bsgrigs pas phreng phab pa dang dkar chag gnyis ka ma dpe la med/ mngon gsal gyi par skyon 'bru re zung bcos shing mjug gi blo sbyong smon lam skabs gug mchan du bris pa ni dpe mtha' zad nas 'bru mi mjal ba la 'ol tshod dang stong pa rnams 'ol tshod ma spobs pa yin/ deb 'di dpar du bskrun pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun gyis byang chub kyi sems mchog rin po che rgyud la myur du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bse mkhar rnam sras kyis rab rgyan shing sprel lo'i zla 6tshes 4rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i du tshes dge ba la// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 94 sga rab 'byams pa kun dga' ye shes/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 93
